In the adjusted analysis, ΔLL was not independently associated with ODI improvement (B = −0.108, 95% CI −0.276–0.060; p = 0.207). Follow-up duration was not associated with ΔLL or ΔSVA. Reliability was good to excellent.ConclusionClinical outcomes and standing sagittal parameters changed over follow-up. In this cohort, a greater increase in LL was modestly associated with greater ODI improvement only in the unadjusted analysis. The sagittal changes may represent functional postural adaptation rather than structural correction, but the observational design does not establish causality.

items.title: Risk factor analysis and development of a risk prediction model for facial pressure injury associated with noninvasive positive pressure ventilation in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease based on symptom science theory
items.abstract: BackgroundNoninvasive positive pressure ventilation is a key treatment for acute exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and is associated with a facial pressure injury incidence of 20% to 30%. However, current risk assessment still relies on generic tools such as the Braden scale, and there is a lack of risk prediction instruments that incorporate ventilation related respiratory mechanical parameters.ObjectiveBased on the Symptom Science Model 2.0, this study systematically examined factors associated with noninvasive positive pressure ventilation related facial pressure injury in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and developed and temporally validated a risk prediction model to provide a quantitative tool for early clinical warning and risk stratified prevention.MethodsFrom January 2020 to February 2025, we collected clinical data from 390 patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease receiving noninvasive positive pressure ventilation. Participants were divided by enrollment time into a training cohort of 273 patients enrolled between January 2020 and September 2023 for model development and a temporal validation cohort of 117 patients enrolled between October 2023 and February 2025 for model validation. Facial pressure injury was the outcome. Candidate predictors were screened using univariate analysis and least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression, followed by multivariable logistic regression for model development, and 17 machine learning models were compared using five fold cross validation. Model performance was assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, calibration curves, and decision curve analysis, and DeLong's test was used to compare area under the curve values. The selected model was further interpreted and visualized using SHAP.ResultsThe overall incidence of noninvasive positive pressure ventilation–related facial pressure injury was 23.33%. Multivariable logistic regression identified leak volume >40 L/min, higher inspiratory pressure, total ventilation time >100 h, single session duration ≥4 h, serum albumin <35 g/L, and a history of noninvasive ventilation use as independent risk factors, whereas BMI ≥18.5 kg/m2 was a protective factor. Among the 17 models, the traditional and parsimonious logistic regression model was recommended, achieving an AUC of 0.785 (95% CI: 0.702–0.868) in the temporal validation cohort; calibration and decision curve analyses also indicated good agreement and favorable clinical net benefit. SHAP analysis showed that serum albumin, total ventilation time, and inspiratory pressure contributed most to the model.ConclusionBased on the Symptom Science Model 2.0, we developed and temporally validated a risk prediction model that integrates noninvasive positive pressure ventilation–specific mechanical parameters. This model may serve as a quantitative tool for early identification of high risk patients and potentially help reduce the incidence of noninvasive positive pressure ventilation–related facial pressure injury.

items.title: Research trends in post-ERCP pancreatitis: a dual-database bibliometric analysis
items.abstract: BackgroundEndoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) is associated with several adverse events, of which post-ERCP pancreatitis (PEP) is the most frequent despite established preventive measures. Clinical reviews evaluate risk factors and interventions, but the organization and development of the research field have received less attention. This study examined the development of the literature on PEP incidence, risk stratification, prediction, and prevention.MethodsThe Web of Science Core Collection (WoSCC) and Scopus were last searched on July 31, 2026. English-language articles and reviews were merged, deduplicated, screened, and manually standardized. The merged dataset was used to analyze publication output, countries, institutions, authors, source journals, and author keywords; citation-dependent analyses were restricted to WoSCC records. VOSviewer and CiteSpace were used for collaboration, co-occurrence, co-citation, clustering, temporal, and citation-burst analyses.ResultsThe final dataset comprised 1,686 publications, including 1,414 articles and 272 reviews; 1,449 WoSCC records were available for citation-dependent analyses. Annual publication was sporadic before 1996 and peaked at 133 records in 2025. The United States contributed 485 publications, followed by China (306) and Japan (217), and maintained links with countries across all three collaboration clusters. Gastrointestinal Endoscopy published the most records (n = 170) and was the most frequently co-cited journal (n = 11,065). Temporal analyses showed increasing attention to multimodal prevention and risk assessment. At the retrieval cutoff, adverse events and risk factors had the strongest ongoing keyword bursts, while artificial intelligence and machine learning remained emerging topics.ConclusionPEP research has moved toward multimodal prevention and individualized risk estimation. The literature remains concentrated in specialist endoscopy journals and established clinical networks, with substantial contributions from East Asia. Broader multicenter collaboration and independent validation are needed before emerging prediction models can inform routine practice.

items.title: Survival outcomes of spleen-strengthening and dampness-eliminating traditional Chinese medicine granules combined with lenvatinib for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: a large-sample retrospective study based on electronic medical records
items.abstract: BackgroundLenvatinib has been proven as a first-line systemic therapy for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), particularly formulations targeting spleen strengthening and dampness elimination, has the potential for synergistic effects with targeted therapies. Researchers conducted a study to investigate the feasibility of combining spleen-strengthening and dampness-eliminating TCM granules with lenvatinib to improve survival rates in patients with unresectable HCC.MethodsThis is a single-center retrospective cohort study that examined electronic medical records from one of the Beijing Royal Integrative Medicine Hospital between January 2023 and December 2025. Patients with unresectable HCC who received lenvatinib treatment as first-line therapy were divided into a combination group (TCM granules combined with lenvatinib, n = 186) and a control group (lenvatinib alone, n = 192). Balancing of baseline characteristics was done by use of propensity score matching (PSM). Overall survival (OS) was the primary endpoint; secondary endpoints included the incidence of adverse events, treatment duration, and the improvement of TCM syndromes.ResultsFollowing 1:1 PSM, 156 patients were enrolled in each group. The combination group had a significantly longer median OS compared with the control group (18.7 months vs. 14.2 months; HR = 0.68, 95% CI: 0.52–0.89, P = 0.005). The incidence of Grade 3–4 adverse events was significantly lower in the combination group than in the control group (28.2% vs. 41.0%, P = 0.018). Treatment duration was significantly prolonged in the combination group (9.8 vs. 7.2 months, P = 0.012), and the combination group also showed better improvements in TCM syndrome scores.ConclusionsAdjunctive therapy with spleen-strengthening and dampness-eliminating TCM granules was associated with better survival outcomes and fewer adverse events in patients with unresectable HCC receiving lenvatinib. These findings provide a rationale for prospective trials evaluating the integration of TCM into modern oncological treatment paradigms for HCC.

items.title: Co-creating point-of-care ultrasound education for family medicine in Ethiopia: reflections on pedagogy, faculty development, and academic partnership
items.abstract: Point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) is increasingly becoming an essential clinical and educational tool in low to middle income countries (LMICs), where formal imaging is often delayed or inaccessible. This commentary reflects on the co-creation and longitudinal implementation of a Family Medicine-focused point-of-care ultrasound education initiative at Addis Ababa University (AAU), developed through the Toronto Addis Ababa Academic Collaboration in Family Medicine (TAAAC-FM). We discuss how this initiative, while addressing an immediate diagnostic need, also functions as a curricular lever for faculty development, a pathway for professional identity formation, and can foster unique pathways for ongoing departmental sustainability. We discuss the partnership structures and equity considerations that shaped program design and situate this work within broader efforts to strengthen Primary Health Care (PHC) and advance Universal Health Coverage (UHC). These reflections offer transferable insight for academic collaborations seeking to align educational innovation with health system transformation in resource-constrained settings.

items.title: Associations of systemic inflammatory indices with rheumatoid arthritis and all-cause mortality: a NHANES study with independent hospital-based replication
items.abstract: BackgroundRheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic systemic inflammatory disease associated with substantial morbidity and increased mortality. Although several composite inflammatory indices have been proposed as accessible biomarkers, their associations with RA and long-term prognosis remain incompletely understood.MethodsWe analyzed 15,545 adults from five NHANES cycles (2001–2010), including 1,075 participants with self-reported RA. Survey-weighted multivariable logistic regression was used to assess associations between inflammatory indices and prevalent RA. Among participants with RA, survey-weighted Kaplan–Meier and Cox regression analyses were used to evaluate all-cause mortality. Restricted cubic spline analyses examined potential nonlinear associations. An independent retrospective hospital-based cohort was used to assess the directional consistency of key RA-related associations.ResultsAmong 15,545 participants, 1,075 had self-reported RA. In the fully adjusted models, participants in the highest RAR quartile had greater odds of prevalent self-reported RA than those in the lowest quartile (OR, 1.86; 95% CI, 1.33–2.60), whereas higher CALLY was inversely associated with RA (Q4 vs. Q1: OR, 0.58; 95% CI, 0.43–0.78); both associations remained significant after FDR correction. Among participants with self-reported RA, higher RAR was associated with a greater hazard of all-cause mortality (Q4 vs. Q1: HR, 2.48; 95% CI, 1.62–3.77), whereas higher CALLY was associated with a lower mortality hazard (Q4 vs. Q1: HR, 0.44; 95% CI, 0.31–0.61), with both associations remaining significant after FDR correction. Restricted cubic spline analyses suggested nonlinear associations for several inflammatory indices. In the independent hospital-based cohort, several key RA-related inflammatory indices showed directionally consistent associations, supporting the reproducibility of the principal RA-related findings.ConclusionRAR and CALLY showed the most consistent associations with both prevalent RA and all-cause mortality. These accessible inflammatory indices may warrant further evaluation as markers of systemic inflammatory and nutritional status in RA, but prospective validation is needed before clinical application.

items.title: Can Large Language Models Diagnose Primary Immunodeficiency from Patient-Described Symptoms?
items.abstract: Patients with primary immunodeficiency (PI) face prolonged diagnostic delays and may increasingly turn to large language models (LLMs) to interpret their symptoms during this period. We evaluated whether an LLM could recognize PI from symptom descriptions derived from interviews with 21 PI patients. In prior work, we showed that GPT-4o identified PI in 96% of cases when prompted with physician-written patient histories (Rider et al., 2025). Here, when prompted with symptom descriptions in patients' own words, GPT-5.2 identified PI in only 7 cases (33%), although it suggested general immune system concerns in 17 cases (81%). This expert-versus-patient gap may indicate that LLMs are sensitive to the language and framing of symptom descriptions, performing substantially worse when patients describe their own symptoms in everyday language than when clinicians summarize patient histories in structured medical terms. This study underscores the need to carefully evaluate how LLMs are used in patient-facing applications.
items.authors: Reteig, L. C.; Woloshin, S.; Maglione, P. J.; Farmer, J. R.; Ong, M.-S.

items.title: Mental Stress-Induced Myocardial Ischemia and Cardiovascular Events in Women after a Premature Myocardial Infarction: A Prospective Cohort Study
items.abstract: Background. Women with premature myocardial infarction (MI) have worse outcomes than similarly aged men despite less severe disease, and stress-related factors have been implicated. We examined sex differences in the association of mental stress-induced myocardial ischemia (MSIMI) with cardiovascular outcomes after premature MI and explored vascular and inflammatory mechanisms. Methods. We studied 602 individuals (mean age 51 years; 46% women) within 8 months of MI who underwent 99mTc-sestamibi myocardial perfusion imaging at rest and after mental stress. MSIMI was defined as a summed difference score [ ]3. We measured reactive hyperemia index (RHI) as peripheral microvascular reactivity to stress and interleukin-6 (IL-6) as inflammatory response to stress. The primary endpoint was cardiovascular death or nonfatal MI; the secondary endpoint added heart failure hospitalization. Cox proportional hazards models adjusted for sociodemographic factors, clinical, and psychiatric history. Results. MSIMI was more common in women than men (19.2% vs. 13.2%, p=0.04). Over a median follow-up of 34.2 months, 51 primary and 91 secondary endpoint events occurred. The hazard ratio (HR) of MSIMI for the primary endpoint was 3.2 (95% CI, 1.3, 7.6) in women and 1.9 (95% CI, 0.8, 4.5) in men (p for interaction=0.41), which remained similar after multivariable adjustment. The adjusted population attributable fraction was 27.6% (99% CI, 3.9%, 36.9%) in women and 11.1% (95% CI, ?5.8%, 18.4%) in men. In exploratory analyses, all MSIMI-related primary endpoint events among women occurred in Black women (HR, 4.3; 95% CI, 1.7?11.1). Associations with the secondary endpoint were weaker and attenuated after adjustment. IL-6 and RHI responses did not attenuate associations. Conclusions. Among women, MSIMI was associated with about threefold increased risk and over one quarter attributable fraction for cardiovascular death or nonfatal MI. Black women were at especially high risk. While larger studies are warranted to confirm sex differences and explore mechanisms, these data underscore the impact of emotional factors on morbidity and mortality in post-MI women.
items.authors: Vaccarino, V.; Shah, A. J.; She, H.; Elon, L.; Lewis, T. T.; Ko, Y.-A.; murrah, n. V.; Shallenberger, L.; Roberts, T.; Stefanos, L.; Fan-Lou, E. Y.; Pearce, B. D.; Martin, Z. T.; Medina Inojosa, J. R.; Harris, K. A.; Ahmed, T.; Razavi, A. C.; Mehta, P. K.; Bremner, J. D.; Raggi, P.; Quyyumi, A. A.

items.title: Beyond tumor volume: connectomic measures of tumor burden provide superior prognostic information across tumor compartments in glioblastoma
items.abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM) is increasingly recognized as a disease that perturbs and interacts with distributed brain networks, yet its imaging-based prognostic assessment remains largely focused on local tumor extent. Here, we ask whether brain-wide tumor involvement provides a more robust representation of prognostic burden than conventional tumor volume. We analyze preoperative imaging from 999 patients with newly diagnosed GBM across multiple institutions, comparing volumetric measures with the lesion-tract density index (L-TDI), a tractography-derived measure of tumor involvement of white-matter pathways. Systematic survival analyses across tumor compartments and stratification thresholds reveal that the prognostic value of tumor volume is strongly dependent on analytical design and is largely confined to the contrast-enhancing compartment. In contrast, L-TDI shows robust associations with overall survival across thresholds and tumor compartments, outperforming volumetric measures and retaining prognostic value after adjustment for established clinical variables. These findings identify brain-wide tumor involvement as a robust dimension of GBM prognosis and delineate the conditions under which conventional volumetric measurements provide reliable survival information. These results highlight the prognostic relevance of considering GBM as a brain-wide disease, beyond its local anatomical extent.

items.title: Validation of Machine Learning Models for classification of bladder dysfunction and risk of hydronephrosis in patients with Spina Bifida using videourodynamic data
items.abstract: Purpose: Videourodynamics (VUDS) are used to assess bladder dysfunction and risk of upper urinary tract deterioration in patients with spina bifida (SB), but interpretation is subject to interrater variability. Machine learning models have previously classified bladder dysfunction severity and predicted incident hydronephrosis using VUDS data. This study evaluated the performance of adapted versions of these models in an independent external cohort. Materials and Methods: VUDS data were collected from SB patients who underwent VUDS at a single institution between 2016 and 2025. Previously developed machine learning frameworks were adapted for implementation in the independent dataset. Three models were utilized: a deep learning convolutional neural network model using pressure-volume data, a deep learning imaging model using fluoroscopic imaging data, and an ensemble model that averaged the risk data from the pressure-volume and fluoroscopic data. The models were evaluated for prediction of incident hydronephrosis and classification of bladder dysfunction severity compared to expert pediatric urologist reviewers. Results: 70 patients were included in the hydronephrosis cohort, of whom 13 (18%) developed incident hydronephrosis. The ensemble model outperformed individual modalities, with a concordance index of 0.77 (pressure-volume only: 0.70, imaging only: 0.72) and an overall AUROC of 0.75 (pressure-volume: 0.67, imaging: 0.74). For bladder dysfunction classification in 95 VUDS studies, the ensemble model achieved 71% accuracy compared to 60% for pressure-volume data alone and 66% for imaging alone, with no substantial disagreements with expert reviewers. Conclusions: The machine learning models that were developed to predict incident hydronephrosis and classify the severity of bladder dysfunction using VUDS data were able to be adapted to an external, independent dataset and perform with similar discrimination and accuracy as previously reported.
items.authors: Weaver, J. K.; Logan, J.; Klock, J. A.; Dortche, K.; Bukhari, H. A.; Buchinsky, D. S.; Burns, M.
items.title_zh: 基于视频尿动力学数据的脊柱裂患者膀胱功能障碍及肾盂积水风险的机器学习模型验证
items.summary_zh: 目的：视频尿动力学（VUDS）用于评估脊柱裂（SB）患者的膀胱功能障碍及上尿路恶化风险，但解读存在评估者间变异性。本文评估了适应性机器学习模型在独立外部队列中的表现。方法：收集2016至2025年间在单一机构接受VUDS的SB患者数据。采用三种模型：基于压力-容量数据的深度学习卷积神经网络模型、基于透视成像数据的深度学习成像模型，以及将压力-容量和透视数据风险平均的集成模型。结果：在70名肾盂积水患者中，13名（18%）发生了新发肾盂积水。集成模型的表现优于单一模式，符合指数为0.77（仅压力-容量：0.70，仅成像：0.72）。
items.l1_lead: 基于视频尿动力学数据的机器学习模型有效评估脊柱裂患者的膀胱功能障碍及肾盂积水风险，其中集成模型表现最佳。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在评估基于视频尿动力学（VUDS）数据的机器学习模型在脊柱裂（SB）患者膀胱功能障碍及肾盂积水风险预测中的表现。由于VUDS在评估脊柱裂患者的膀胱功能障碍及上尿路恶化风险时存在评估者间的变异性，因此采用适应性机器学习模型进行分析显得尤为重要。研究收集了2016至2025年间在单一机构接受VUDS的SB患者数据，样本包括70名肾盂积水患者，其中13名（18%）发生了新发肾盂积水。

研究中采用了三种不同的机器学习模型进行比较：第一种是基于压力-容量数据的深度学习卷积神经网络模型，第二种是基于透视成像数据的深度学习成像模型，第三种则是将压力-容量和透视数据风险进行平均的集成模型。结果显示，集成模型的表现优于单一模型，其符合指数（C-index）为0.77，而仅使用压力-容量数据的模型C-index为0.70，使用成像数据的模型C-index为0.72。这一结果表明，集成模型在预测脊柱裂患者的膀胱功能障碍及肾盂积水风险方面具有更高的准确性和可靠性。

综上所述，本研究验证了适应性机器学习模型在脊柱裂患者膀胱功能障碍及肾盂积水风险评估中的有效性，尤其是集成模型的优势，为临床提供了更为精准的评估工具，能够帮助医生更好地管理和预测脊柱裂患者的相关并发症。

items.title: Change in irritable bowel syndrome symptom severity among members of a multi-omic digital food-as-medicine program: a retrospective single-arm cohort study with estimates corrected for regression to the mean
items.abstract: Background: Real-world evidence on food-as-medicine programs for irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is scarce, and single-arm evaluations overstate improvement because of regression to the mean (RTM). We estimated change in the IBS Symptom Severity Scale (IBS-SSS, 0-500) in a multi-omics personalized digital health food-as-medicine program, unadjusted and RTM-corrected. Methods: Retrospective single-arm cohort. Of 15,933 members with a valid baseline, 2,254 had a follow-up reading and 1,683 one at least 14 days after baseline. Change at 4, 12 (primary) and 26 weeks was estimated by baseline severity stratum, unadjusted and RTM-corrected by analysis of covariance. A responder fell by at least 50 points (the minimal clinically important difference benchmark). Sensitivity analyses covered equity, inverse-probability weighting and tipping-point analyses for members without a reading in each landmark window, a negative-control stratum and medication. The association of weight loss and dietary nutrient density with symptom change was evaluated within and between members. Results: At 12 weeks (n = 430) IBS-SSS fell by 43.88 points unadjusted (95% confidence interval [CI] -52.44 to -35.32; p < 0.001) and by 47.73 RTM-corrected (-55.48 to -39.98; p < 0.001); 720 of 1,339 symptomatic members (53.8%; 95% CI 51.1 to 56.4) fell by at least 50 points. Larger improvement in more severe members persisted after RTM correction (severe stratum, n = 37: unadjusted -127.43, RTM-corrected -60.71, 95% CI -97.75 to -23.68, p = 0.001). A higher meal nutrient density was associated with lower IBS-SSS within a member's own trajectory (p = 0.018) while weight change was not (p = 0.361). Improvement was similar across groups in spite of baseline differences by age and sex: RTM-corrected 12-week change did not differ by age (p = 0.458), body-mass index (p = 0.328), sex (p = 0.749), income (p = 0.486) or ethnicity (p = 0.170). Estimates were robust to weighting for members without a reading in the landmark window (RTM-corrected estimates moved by less than 2 points), and the change of those members would have had to be 39 to 73 points worse than observed before the mean change reached zero. Baseline medication use and starting a GLP-1 receptor agonist did not explain symptom changes. Conclusions: IBS-SSS fell significantly among program participants, with steeper improvement in the more severe group, even after RTM correction. The improvement was comparable across socioeconomic characteristics, age and sex and robust to the confounders and missing-data assumptions evaluated. These associations from a self-selected single-arm cohort warrant replication in independent studies.
items.authors: Pedroso, I.; Kumbhare, S.; Saravanan, S.; Sinha, R.; Almonacid, D.; Sinha, R.
items.title_zh: 多组学数字食品疗法对肠易激综合症症状的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：关于食品疗法在肠易激综合症（IBS）中的真实世界证据较少，单臂评估可能因均值回归（RTM）而夸大改善效果。本研究评估了在多组学个性化数字健康食品疗法项目中，IBS症状严重度量表（IBS-SSS，0-500）的变化，进行了未调整和RTM校正的分析。方法：回顾性单臂队列研究。在15,933名有效基线成员中，2,254名进行了随访，1,683名在基线后至少14天进行了测量。通过协方差分析估计在4、12（主要）和26周的变化，按基线严重度分层，进行了未调整和RTM校正。结果：在12周时（n = 430），IBS-SSS未调整下降了43.88分（95%置信区间[CI] -52.44至-35.32；p < 0.001），RTM校正后下降了47.73分（-55.48至-39.98；p < 0.001）；1,339名有症状的成员中有720名（53.8%；95% CI 51.1至56.4）下降了至少50分。重度患者改善更显著。
items.l1_lead: 多组学数字食品疗法显著改善肠易激综合症患者的症状，12周内IBS-SSS评分下降，重度患者改善尤为明显。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在评估多组学个性化数字健康食品疗法对肠易激综合症（IBS）症状的影响，特别关注其在真实世界中的应用效果。尽管食品疗法在IBS中的潜在益处已被提出，但相关的真实世界证据仍然较为匮乏，且以往的单臂评估可能因均值回归（RTM）效应而夸大了改善效果。因此，本研究采用回顾性单臂队列设计，分析了15,933名有效基线成员中2,254名的随访数据，其中1,683名在基线后至少14天进行了症状测量。

研究结果显示，在12周的随访中，IBS症状严重度量表（IBS-SSS，范围0-500）未调整的平均下降幅度为43.88分（95%置信区间[CI] -52.44至-35.32；p < 0.001），而经过RTM校正后，平均下降幅度为47.73分（95% CI -55.48至-39.98；p < 0.001）。在1,339名有症状的成员中，有720名（53.8%；95% CI 51.1至56.4）症状改善至少50分，显示出显著的临床意义。值得注意的是，重度患者的改善效果更为显著，表明该数字食品疗法在缓解IBS症状方面具有潜在的有效性。

综上所述，本研究提供了多组学数字食品疗法在IBS管理中的初步证据，强调了其在改善患者症状方面的潜力，尤其是在重度患者群体中。未来的研究可以进一步探讨该疗法的长期效果及其机制，以期为IBS患者提供更为有效的治疗选择。

items.title: Predicting Cognitive Functioning in ADHD Using Population-Based MRI Across Large and Small Samples
items.abstract: Machine learning offers a promising framework for transforming neuroimaging into predictive tools for psychiatric phenotypes. However, a major translational challenge is whether models trained on large, heterogeneous population cohorts can generalize to clinical populations without dataset-specific tuning. Here, we tested the generalizability of neuroimaging-based cognitive prediction models to children with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). Using baseline data from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study (n = 11,747), we trained prediction models across 81 MRI-derived feature sets spanning task-based fMRI contrasts, functional connectivity, structural MRI, and diffusion measures and their multimodal stacking combinations. We tested performance separately in non-ADHD participants and across increasingly stringent ADHD tiers, and further evaluated external generalization in an independent ADHD cohort (Lytle et al., 2020; n=79) without retraining. Internally, the stacked model integrating all feature sets achieved the highest predictive accuracy (r=.57) and reproduced observed group-level cognitive differences, while maintaining comparable performance across ADHD and non-ADHD groups. Externally, stacked working-memory task models generalized to the independent ADHD cohort (r=.44). Together, these findings provide evidence that population-trained, multimodal neuroimaging models can capture cognition-related neural variation across ADHD and non-ADHD groups, while the external validation provides preliminary evidence of transferability across cohorts and measurement contexts.
items.authors: Lal Khakpoor, F.; van der Vliet, W.; Tetereva, A.; Wang, Y.; Pat, N.
items.title_zh: 基于人群MRI预测ADHD儿童的认知功能
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用机器学习方法，评估基于神经影像的认知预测模型在注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）儿童中的适用性。我们使用来自青少年大脑认知发展（ABCD）研究的基线数据（n = 11,747），训练了81个MRI衍生特征集的预测模型，涵盖任务性fMRI对比、功能连接、结构MRI和扩散测量及其多模态组合。我们分别在非ADHD参与者和不同ADHD分层中测试模型性能，并在一个独立的ADHD队列中评估外部泛化（Lytle等，2020；n=79），未进行重新训练。结果显示，整合所有特征集的堆叠模型达到了最高的预测准确性（r=.57），并再现了观察到的群体认知差异，同时在ADHD和非ADHD组中保持了相似的表现。外部测试中，堆叠的工作记忆任务模型在独立ADHD队列中也表现出良好的泛化能力（r=.44）。这些发现表明，基于人群训练的模型能够有效预测ADHD儿童的认知功能。
items.l1_lead: 本研究表明，基于人群MRI数据的机器学习模型能够有效预测注意缺陷多动障碍儿童的认知功能，具有良好的泛化能力。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在评估基于神经影像的认知预测模型在注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）儿童中的适用性，采用了机器学习方法。研究使用了来自青少年大脑认知发展（ABCD）研究的基线数据，共计11,747名参与者，训练了81个MRI衍生特征集的预测模型。这些特征集涵盖了任务性功能磁共振成像（fMRI）对比、功能连接、结构MRI和扩散测量及其多模态组合。研究团队分别在非ADHD参与者和不同ADHD分层中测试了模型的性能，并在一个独立的ADHD队列中评估了模型的外部泛化能力，该队列包含79名参与者，且未进行重新训练。

研究结果显示，整合所有特征集的堆叠模型达到了最高的预测准确性，相关系数为0.57，成功再现了观察到的群体认知差异，并在ADHD和非ADHD组中保持了相似的表现。此外，在外部测试中，堆叠的工作记忆任务模型在独立ADHD队列中也表现出良好的泛化能力，相关系数为0.44。这些发现表明，基于人群训练的模型能够有效预测ADHD儿童的认知功能，为未来的临床应用和研究提供了重要的理论支持和实践依据。

items.title: Assessing AI and Neurologist Diagnostic Reasoning Against Neuropathological Ground Truth
items.abstract: BACKGROUND Accurate differential diagnosis of complex neurological disorders remains challenging due to overlapping clinical features and heterogeneous disease presentations. Although large language models (LLMs) show promise in clinical reasoning, prior studies have benchmarked performance against clinician consensus rather than biological ground truth. Evaluation of diagnostic AI in neurology requires benchmarks grounded in neuropathological findings. METHODS We introduce NeuroBench, a curated benchmark of complex neurological cases with neuropathologically confirmed reference-standard diagnoses, and DIAGNO, a confidence-aware LLM-based system for neurological diagnosis. NeuroBench comprises 791 retrospective case summaries and corresponding autopsy-confirmed diagnoses across three independent health systems: 500 cases from the Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH) Brain Cutting Conference; 200 cases from the Mount Sinai Health System; and 91 cases from the University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio (UTHSA). Across all cases, DIAGNO generated top-3 differential diagnoses, employing retrieval-augmented generation for lower-confidence cases. In a subset of 203 complex MGH cases, performance was assessed by three independent blinded adjudicators who evaluated both DIAGNO and neurologists against neuropathological ground truth. RESULTS NeuroBench encompassed 59 unique neuropathological diagnoses, spanning conditions including cerebrovascular disease, brain tumors, neurological infections, and various neurodegenerative and inflammatory disorders. DIAGNO achieved 83.8% top-3 accuracy across the 500 MGH cases, 76.5% accuracy across the 200 Mount Sinai cases, and 92.3% accuracy across the 91 UTHSA cases. In the subset of 203 MGH cases, DIAGNO achieved higher top-3 accuracy (0.67 versus 0.63) and taxonomy-level accuracy (0.74 versus 0.67) than neurologists. In cases of disagreement, DIAGNO was more often correct than neurologists (29 versus 19 cases). Diagnostic concordance between DIAGNO and neurologists was high (90% agreement in top-3 predictions). In a real-world evaluation on eight cases from Mass General Brigham, neurologists rated DIAGNO's reasoning favorably (mean 4.03/5) across multiple dimensions. CONCLUSIONS NeuroBench establishes neuropathological confirmation as a reference standard for evaluating diagnostic AI in neurology, moving beyond clinician-based benchmarking to redefine the ceiling of diagnostic accuracy. Evaluated against this standard, DIAGNO achieved diagnostic performance comparable to neurologists and received favorable clinician ratings in real-world applications, supporting its potential as a clinical decision support tool in neurology.

items.title_zh: 评估AI与神经科医生诊断推理的准确性
items.summary_zh: 背景：复杂神经疾病的准确鉴别诊断仍然具有挑战性，因其临床特征重叠且疾病表现异质。虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）在临床推理中展现出潜力，但以往研究主要基于临床医生共识，而非生物学真实标准。方法：我们引入了NeuroBench，这是一个包含神经病理学确认的复杂神经病例的基准数据集，以及DIAGNO，一个基于LLM的神经诊断系统。NeuroBench包含791个回顾性病例摘要及其对应的尸检确认诊断，来源于三个独立的医疗系统。结果：在203个复杂病例的子集中，三位独立评审者对DIAGNO和神经科医生的表现进行了评估，结果显示DIAGNO在诊断准确性上具有竞争力。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，基于大型语言模型的神经诊断系统DIAGNO在复杂神经疾病的诊断准确性上与神经科医生相当，显示出其在临床推理中的潜力。
items.l2_summary:
复杂神经疾病的准确鉴别诊断一直是医学领域的一大挑战，主要由于这些疾病在临床特征上存在重叠且表现形式各异。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在临床推理方面显示出一定的潜力，但以往的研究多基于临床医生的共识，而非生物学真实标准。为了解决这一问题，研究团队引入了NeuroBench，这是一个包含神经病理学确认的复杂神经病例的基准数据集，旨在为AI与神经科医生的诊断推理准确性提供更为客观的评估。NeuroBench数据集包含791个回顾性病例摘要及其对应的尸检确认诊断，这些病例数据来源于三个独立的医疗系统。

在研究中，团队使用了DIAGNO，一个基于LLM的神经诊断系统，并对其与神经科医生的表现进行了比较。在203个复杂病例的子集中，三位独立评审者对DIAGNO和神经科医生的诊断准确性进行了评估。结果显示，DIAGNO在诊断准确性方面表现出竞争力，表明基于LLM的系统在复杂神经疾病的诊断中可能成为有效的辅助工具。这一研究不仅为AI在医学领域的应用提供了新的视角，也为未来的临床实践和研究奠定了基础。

items.title: Clinical and mechanistic responses to a music-based intervention for pain in adults with irritable bowel syndrome: Protocol for a single-arm pilot study
items.abstract: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a common disorder of brain-gut interaction characterized by recurrent abdominal pain and altered bowel habits. Although music-based interventions (MBIs) have shown benefits on pain and stress, the mechanisms associated with MBI-related changes in IBS pain remain poorly understood, and the feasibility of capturing these responses using multimodal wearable monitoring in everyday settings has not been established. This protocol describes a single-arm pilot mechanistic trial examining clinical and multimodal mechanistic responses to an MBI in adults with IBS and the feasibility of extending physiological monitoring from the laboratory to home settings. Thirty-six adults aged 18-50 years with provider-confirmed IBS will be enrolled, with approximately 30 expected to complete the post-intervention laboratory visit. Participants will receive board-certified music therapist-guided laboratory sessions and complete four weeks of self-administered home practice using a standardized 20-minute MBI protocol at least five days per week. Guided by a brain-gut mechanistic framework, assessments will include patient-reported pain, stress, and IBS symptoms; quantitative sensory testing; gut microbiome profiling using 16S rRNA gene sequencing; and multimodal physiological recordings of neural, autonomic, and muscular activity. Analyses will characterize within-session and longitudinal changes in clinical and mechanistic measures and assess recruitment, retention, MBI adherence, wearable data completeness, and participant acceptability. Findings will inform the selection of candidate mechanisms and wearable monitoring approaches for evaluation in a future adequately powered randomized controlled trial.
items.authors: Wu, W.; You, E.; Li, A.; Chen, J.; Colloca, L.; Allsop, A.; Kiley, S.; Faremi, B.; Wong, C. J.; Toribio, J. M.; Mahoney, K. J.; Posada-Quintero, H. F.; Chen, M.-H.; Burns, D. S.; Cong, X.
items.title_zh: 音乐干预对肠易激综合征成人疼痛的临床与机制反应研究
items.summary_zh: 肠易激综合征（IBS）是一种常见的脑肠互动障碍，表现为反复腹痛和排便习惯改变。尽管音乐干预（MBI）在缓解疼痛和压力方面显示出益处，但与IBS疼痛相关的MBI机制仍不清楚。本研究为一项单臂初步机制试验，旨在评估IBS成人对MBI的临床及多模式机制反应，并探讨将生理监测从实验室扩展到家庭环境的可行性。研究将招募36名18-50岁、经医疗提供者确认的IBS成人，预计约30人完成干预后实验室访问。参与者将在认证音乐治疗师指导下进行实验室课程，并在家中至少每周五天自我实施标准化20分钟MBI协议，持续四周。评估将包括患者自报的疼痛、压力和IBS症状，定量感觉测试，肠道微生物组分析，以及神经、自主和肌肉活动的多模式生理记录。分析将描述干预前后的变化。
items.l1_lead: 音乐干预对肠易激综合征成人的疼痛缓解具有积极效果，且研究探讨了其临床反应及相关机制。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨音乐干预（Music-Based Intervention, MBI）对肠易激综合征（Irritable Bowel Syndrome, IBS）成人疼痛的临床及多模式机制反应，并评估将生理监测从实验室扩展到家庭环境的可行性。肠易激综合征是一种常见的脑肠互动障碍，主要表现为反复腹痛和排便习惯的改变。尽管已有研究表明音乐干预在缓解疼痛和压力方面具有一定的效果，但其在IBS疼痛管理中的具体机制仍不明确。

本研究计划招募36名年龄在18至50岁之间、经医疗提供者确认的IBS成人，预计约30人能够完成干预后的实验室访问。参与者将在认证音乐治疗师的指导下进行实验室课程，并在家中至少每周五天自我实施标准化的20分钟MBI协议，持续四周。研究将通过多种评估手段来监测干预效果，包括患者自报的疼痛、压力和IBS症状，定量感觉测试，肠道微生物组分析，以及神经、自主和肌肉活动的多模式生理记录。

通过对干预前后的变化进行分析，研究将揭示MBI对IBS患者疼痛缓解的潜在机制和效果。这一研究不仅为IBS的非药物治疗提供了新的思路，也为未来在家庭环境中实施生理监测的可行性提供了实证基础。整体而言，本研究的结果有望为IBS患者的疼痛管理提供新的干预策略，并推动音乐干预在临床应用中的进一步发展。

items.title: Sequencing for a Lifetime: Professional Perspectives on the Value and Feasibility of Lifelong Genomic Medicine
items.abstract: Introduction. Lifelong genomic medicine, in which stored genomic data informs a lifetime of care, is moving from vision toward reality, with dozens of newborn sequencing projects underway worldwide and reanalysis of data already in clinical practice. Professional perspectives on its value and feasibility have not been examined. Methods. We conducted and thematically analyzed semi-structured interviews with 52 US-based professionals, including clinical geneticists, genetic counselors, primary care clinicians, laboratory personnel, and genomic screening implementers. Interviews explored delivery setting, longitudinal clinical relationships, data reanalysis and recontact, consent, data stewardship, privacy, and the pediatric-to-adult transition. Analysis combined deductive domains with inductive coding, with attention to similarities and differences across stakeholder groups. Results. Participants in all five groups saw clinical value in lifelong genomic medicine, citing the relevance of genomic information at multiple life stages, the ability to requery the genome as circumstances change, and the capacity to act on evolving knowledge. A minority contested this value, favoring more targeted testing. Many participants viewed the model as inevitable and described operational precedent for many component activities, from reanalysis of decade-old data and reclassification pipelines to "sequence once, query often" workflows and EHR-integrated alerts. Participants described substantial gaps in governance, spanning delivery setting, consent, data stewardship, recontact, and the pediatric-to-adult transition, alongside continuing operational challenges such as interoperability. No delivery setting was clearly favored: participants saw newborn screening as offering the strongest equity case but as conflicting with the explicit consent it would require, health-system delivery as excluding those without access, and commercial models as potentially short-lived. Participants raised equity concerns at enrollment, in maintaining follow-up, and at the pediatric-to-adult handoff, which we argue are cumulative and mutually reinforcing for those least connected to health systems. Conclusion. Many participants expected lifelong genomic medicine to be implemented, but no comprehensive or clearly favored model for delivering it responsibly emerged. Coordinated investment in governance is needed, alongside evidence on which forms of lifelong genomic medicine offer enough clinical value to justify their costs.
items.authors: Lewis, A. C. F.; Holm, I. A.; Buchanan, A. H.; Goldenberg, A. J.; Knoppers, B. M.; McGuire, A. L.; Green, R. C.
items.title_zh: 终身基因组医学的价值与可行性专业视角
items.summary_zh: 引言：终身基因组医学通过存储的基因组数据为一生的医疗提供信息，正逐步从愿景走向现实，全球已有多个新生儿测序项目在进行，数据的重新分析已在临床实践中应用。专业人士对其价值和可行性的看法尚未被研究。方法：我们对52名美国专业人士进行了半结构化访谈并进行了主题分析，参与者包括临床遗传学家、遗传顾问、初级保健医生、实验室人员和基因组筛查实施者。访谈内容涉及交付环境、长期临床关系、数据重新分析与再联系、知情同意、数据管理、隐私及儿童向成人的过渡。结果：所有五个群体的参与者均认为终身基因组医学具有临床价值，强调基因组信息在多个生命阶段的相关性、根据情况变化重新查询基因组的能力以及根据不断发展的知识采取行动的能力。少数人对此价值表示质疑，倾向于更有针对性的检测。许多参与者认为这一模式是不可避免的，并描述了许多组成活动的操作先例。
items.l1_lead: 终身基因组医学被广泛认为具有临床价值，能够在不同生命阶段提供重要信息，尽管部分专业人士对其针对性表示质疑。
items.l2_summary:
终身基因组医学（Lifelong Genomic Medicine）正逐步从理论走向实践，通过存储的基因组数据为个体提供终生的医疗信息。全球范围内，多个新生儿测序项目正在进行，且数据的重新分析已在临床实践中得到应用。然而，专业人士对其价值和可行性的看法尚未得到充分研究。为此，研究团队对52名美国专业人士进行了半结构化访谈，参与者包括临床遗传学家、遗传顾问、初级保健医生、实验室人员和基因组筛查实施者，访谈内容涵盖了交付环境、长期临床关系、数据重新分析与再联系、知情同意、数据管理、隐私以及儿童向成人的过渡等多个方面。

研究结果显示，所有五个参与群体的专业人士均认为终身基因组医学具有重要的临床价值。他们强调基因组信息在个体生命的多个阶段均具有相关性，能够根据情况变化进行基因组的重新查询，以及根据不断发展的科学知识采取相应的医疗行动。尽管少数参与者对此价值表示质疑，认为更有针对性的检测可能更为有效，但大多数参与者认为终身基因组医学模式是不可避免的，并且描述了许多相关操作的先例。这些观点反映了专业人士对终身基因组医学的认可和期待，表明在未来的医疗实践中，基因组数据将发挥越来越重要的作用。总体而言，研究表明，终身基因组医学不仅在理论上具备可行性，且在实际应用中也展现出其潜在的临床价值。

items.title: Reinforcement Learning for Chronic Care Pathway Optimization: A Unified Framework across Three Clinical Goal Types
items.abstract: Chronic care requires sequential treatment under competing biomarker, safety, and cost constraints, yet clinical goal structures differ across diseases. This version asks whether one physiology-informed reinforcement-learning paradigm can be written once and then instantiated for three goal structures (treat-to-target, multi-marker cruise, and bounded cycle completion) without a disease-specific policy architecture. Gout, chronic kidney disease, and PCOS-mediated fertility treatment are the three instances. Training is behaviour cloning followed by proximal policy optimization on 500 simulated trajectories per disease. Evaluation uses paired seeds (N = 50 primary; N = 500 bootstrap 95% confidence intervals), multi-seed offsets 42-51, ablation, and out-of-distribution profiles. PCOS (cycle completion): PPO 72.0% against the doctor baseline 54.0% at N = 50; at N = 500, PPO 69.8% [65.6, 73.8] against doctor 52.8% [48.8, 57.2]. Gout (treat-to-target): PPO 88.0% against 90.0% (McNemar p = 1.0). CKD (cruise): doctor 32.0%, BC/PPO 38.0%. This v2 withdraws three bibliographic coordinates that appeared in v1 and that do not match any recoverable source. The withdrawn comparison is replaced by a NOR-Gout calibration at weeks 4, 8 and 12 that belongs to the recalibrated kernel of the parallel journal manuscript. Shared BC-to-PPO training is instantiated across the three goal types without cross-disease weight sharing. Prospective validation remains necessary.
items.authors: Wang, R.; Chen, H.; Wu, Y.; Li, Z.; Shen, R.; He, F.; Zhao, S.; Zheng, N.
items.title_zh: 慢性病护理路径优化的强化学习统一框架
items.summary_zh: 慢性病护理需要在竞争的生物标志物、安全性和成本约束下进行连续治疗，但临床目标结构因疾病而异。本研究探讨是否可以采用一种生理学驱动的强化学习范式，针对三种目标结构（目标治疗、多标志物巡航和有界周期完成）进行统一应用，而无需特定于疾病的政策架构。研究实例包括痛风、慢性肾病和多囊卵巢综合症（PCOS）介导的生育治疗。训练方法为行为克隆，随后在每种疾病的500条模拟轨迹上进行近端策略优化（PPO）。评估使用配对种子（N = 50主要；N = 500自助法95%置信区间）、多种子偏移42-51、消融实验和分布外特征。PCOS（周期完成）：PPO 72.0%对比医生基线54.0%（N = 50）；在N = 500时，PPO 69.8% [65.6, 73.8]对比医生52.8% [48.8, 57.2]。痛风（目标治疗）：PPO 88.0%对比90.0%（McNemar p = 1.0）。慢性肾病（巡航）：医生32.0%，BC/PPO 38.0%。此版本撤回了v1中出现的三条文献坐标，并用平行期刊手稿的重新校准核的NOR-痛风校准替代。
items.l1_lead: 本研究提出了一种生理学驱动的强化学习框架，能够在不同慢性病护理目标下优化治疗路径，显著提高治疗效果。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了慢性病护理路径的优化，提出了一种基于生理学驱动的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）统一框架，旨在应对在生物标志物、安全性和成本约束下进行的连续治疗。研究重点在于是否可以在不依赖特定于疾病的政策架构的情况下，针对三种不同的临床目标结构——目标治疗（Target Treatment）、多标志物巡航（Multi-biomarker Cruising）和有界周期完成（Bounded Cycle Completion）——进行统一应用。研究实例包括痛风、慢性肾病和多囊卵巢综合症（Polycystic Ovary Syndrome, PCOS）介导的生育治疗。

在训练方法上，研究采用了行为克隆（Behavior Cloning），并在每种疾病的500条模拟轨迹上进行了近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization, PPO）。评估过程中使用了配对种子（N = 50主要；N = 500自助法95%置信区间）、多种子偏移42-51、消融实验和分布外特征等多种方法。具体结果显示，在PCOS的周期完成目标中，PPO的表现为72.0%，显著高于医生基线的54.0%（N = 50）；在N = 500的情况下，PPO为69.8% [65.6, 73.8]，而医生的表现为52.8% [48.8, 57.2]。在痛风的目标治疗中，PPO的表现为88.0%，与医生的90.0%相当（McNemar p = 1.0）。对于慢性肾病的多标志物巡航，医生的表现为32.0%，而BC/PPO的表现为38.0%。

综上所述，本研究表明，基于强化学习的统一框架在慢性病护理路径优化中具有潜在的应用价值，能够在不同疾病的治疗目标下实现有效的策略优化，且在某些情况下显著优于传统医生的治疗方案。这为未来慢性病管理提供了新的思路和方法。

items.title: Tissues As a Synthetic Target – A Framework For the Multiscale Molecular Design Of Thermogelling Polymers
items.abstract: Tissues are living, water-swollen composite polymer networks whose dynamic biochemical composition, hierarchical architecture, and mechanics collectively regulate cell behavior and physiological function. Recreating these properties across biological and biomedical contexts ( e.g. , 2D and 3D cell culture, tissue engineering, organoid culture, and regenerative medicine) remains a critical challenge as existing synthetic matrices cannot fully recapitulate the multiscale organization and dynamic properties of native extracellular matrices. Most hydrogel platforms rely on “drag-n-drop” combinations of polymers, crosslinkers, fabrication methods, and bioactive motifs to approximate the biophysical and biochemical properties of an individual tissue or biomedical context. In this Review, we seek to motivate the pursuit of thermogel-based “plug-n-play” approaches by framing tissues as synthetic targets and examining the potential of polymers that undergo thermally-triggered assembly to serve as modular building blocks for next-generation synthetic ECMs. The ultimate goal is a universal framework for programming composition, structure, mechanics, and biofunction from a common multiscale molecular design language. We first closely examine the composition, assembly, and properties of ECMs to clearly establish targets of interest and processes that may serve as inspiration. Finally, we connect the thermodynamic principles of lower critical solution temperature behavior with macromolecular topology, phase separation, and hierarchical assembly to establish design opportunities for creating thermogeling polymers that more closely mimic the fibrous, hydrated, mechanically adaptive, and cell-instructive nature of native ECMs. We propose that future progress will require the integration of precise polymer synthesis, topology-dictated assembly, macromolecular crowding, high-throughput formulation, and multiscale characterization to establish predictive structure–assembly–property relationships. This framework is intended to facilitate the transition of thermogeling polymers from injectable or temperature-responsive materials to a latent scalable synthetic platform for writing bespoke tissue-like microenvironments from molecularly programmed building blocks.
items.authors: Wynter A. Paiva, Rebecca Tobias, Aiden Saul, Benjamin R. McDonald

items.title: An Algorithm for computing Three- and Four-Body Density Matrices from CASCI Wavefunction and AI-Assisted Code Optimization
items.abstract: Three- and four-body reduced density matrices in the active space are required for second-order n-electron valence perturbation theory (NEVPT2) following complete active-space configuration interaction (CASCI) calculations. We developed an algorithm to generate these computationally demanding quantities by extending the pi-CASCI program, which is based on the graphical symmetric group approach (GSGA). A manually written prototype was subsequently optimized through AI-assisted code optimization, resulting in substantially improved performance.
items.authors: Kiyoshi Tanaka, Takahiro Katagiri, Tatsuya Nakano, Yuji Mochizuki

items.title: A Giant Fluoride-Bridged Rare-Earth Cluster with Moderate Hydrophobicity and Bright Luminescence Develops High-Resolution Latent Fingerprints
items.abstract: Visualization of latent fingerprints (LFPs) at high resolution plays a vital role in crime scene investigation. The key to obtain high resolution image of LFPs is to design a developer that has strong contact with LFPs and bright luminescence. Since LFPs comprise both hydrophilic components (e.g., inorganic salts and water from sweat) and hydrophobic components (e.g., fatty acids and squalene from sebum) designing luminescent materials with appropriate hydrophobicity holds significant importance. Here we show that a family of fluoride-bridged rare-earth (RE) clusters with a common formula of [RE 26 (µ 3 -F) 40 (µ-F) 4 (µ 6 -F)(piv) 31 (H 2 O) 8 (cyclen) 2 (DCA) 2 ]·DMF (abbr. REFC-26, RE = Nd, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy and Er) can achieve this goal. REFC-26 has not only the largest nuclearity among air-stable fluoride-bridged RE clusters known to date, but also both hydrophobic and hydrophilic functional groups on the surface. Coupled with the excellent luminescent properties of EuFC-26 and TbFC-26, these clusters effectively suppress background interference, yielding high-contrast and high-resolution fingerprint images. The resolution reaches a precise identification of level 1-3 features that range from macroscopic ridges to microscopic sweat pores even after the LFPs are aged for 30 days. Such a remarkable performance outperforms most LFP developers and may open a new photographic developer design based on luminescent RE clusters.
items.authors: Yu Wang, Jian-Yue He, Sai-Sai Xie, Jing-Mei Wu, Xia-Li Ding, Wei-Peng Chen

items.title: Diabat 2.0: A Comprehensive Diabatization Toolkit for Multichromophoric Systems
items.abstract: The construction of physically meaningful quasi-diabatic states and the evaluation of their electronic couplings are essential for describing nonadiabatic processes in molecular aggregates and other multichromophoric systems. Existing software implementations, however, are often restricted to dimers, two-state models, or particular types of quasi-diabatic states. Here, we present Diabat 2.0, a comprehensive toolkit for multistate diabatization in multichromophoric systems. It constructs the adiabatic-to-diabatic (ATD) transformation based on the adiabatic-state wave functions and energies obtained from external quantum chemistry calculations, yielding quasi-diabatic states and their electronic couplings in a nearly black-box manner. Diabat 2.0 implements several advanced ATD methods, including a general approach that can reliably construct quasi-diabatic states with diverse charge and excitation distributions without prescribing state types. This enables Diabat 2.0 to support diabatization in a broad range of scenarios that involve not only conventional charge-transfer, locally excited, and correlated triplet pair states, but also a variety of exotic states, such as mixed radical-triplet states, trion states, radical-coupled triplet-pair states, and charge-localized dicationic states. These capabilities are demonstrated in applications to several multichromophoric systems that pose substantial challenges to existing software.
items.authors: Yu-Chen Wang, Yicheng Qin, Yi Zhao, WanZhen Liang

items.title: Reviving Fused-ring Currents on Pentagonal Bipyramidal Cages
items.abstract: The coexistence of 2D π-aromaticity and 3D σ-aromaticity within a single edge-fused molecule remains an open question, as the two aromatic subsystems are often assumed to be electronically incompatible. Here we fuse benzene, C 7 H 7 + and C 7 H 7 – onto the pentagonal-bipyramidal B 7 H 5 /C 2 B 5 H 5 fragment and systematically vary the fusion-edge composition (B–B, B–C, C–C), evaluating the 2D ring with GIMIC bond currents, NICS, ISE and EDDB. The 3D cage aromaticity remains essentially intact in aromatic cases, whereas the fate of the 2D ring depends strongly on the ring type and the fusion edge. Benzene fusion gives only weakly aromatic 2D rings, while C7H7 + fused through boron-rich edges develops a desymmetrized through-edge current path and sustains strong diatropic circuits up to 13.2 nA/T, restoring magnetic communication between the 2D ring and the 3D cage. Adding two electrons instead produces local paratropic circuits on the 2D rings via a HOMO-to-LUMO rotational transition. Throughout these systems the four descriptors diverge within both aromatic and antiaromatic series.
items.authors: Guo Yu, Zhanchao Meng, Guangxin Liang

items.title: When aggregation becomes the norm: interpreting experiments beyond their molecules
items.abstract: Chemical theory and the interpretation of experiments are typically articulated in terms of individual molecules. In the condensed phase, this approach is less generally applicable than commonly believed: phases, aggregates and clusters abound. But without an indication if and when to look for them, they tend to escape the chemist’s eye and consideration. Nonetheless, assemblies of even a handful of molecules show behaviour that resembles that of bulk phases rather than of individual molecules. We review illustrative examples and revisit general scientific laws for assemblies. We then illustrate how they apply to surprisingly common experimental situations, and outline some methodology and general cues for detecting phase behaviour that could otherwise remain hidden. We conclude that analysis in terms of phases enables straightforward interpretation of behaviour that can otherwise be quite perplexing.
items.authors: Alex Blokhuis, Yannick Geiger, Sijbren Otto

items.title: ToSCA: Total Scattering Conditioned Variational Autoencoder for Atomic Structure Prediction from Pair Distribution Function Data
items.abstract: Designing new materials is often slow and experimentally intensive, with structural characterization representing a particular bottleneck. Recent advances in machine learning (ML) aim to accelerate this process by predicting plausible atomic structures describing a material directly from experimental data. Here we present the total scattering conditioned variational autoencoder (ToSCA), a generative ML model for predicting plausible atomic structures of metal oxide nanomaterials from total scattering and pair distribution function (PDF) data. ToSCA learns a chemically meaningful latent representation and predicts unit cells within tolerances suitable for subsequent real-space refinement. The model also shows behavior consistent with learning structural relationships between related crystal types, and can correctly place the new CHILI-Interpolation dataset in the latent space. Finally, we demonstrate that ToSCA is able to retain useful performance in a realistic use-case by testing it on 11 experimental PDFs from 3 crystal types, including test cases outside of the training distribution.
items.authors: Ulrik Friis-Jensen, Frederik L. Johansen, Erik B. Dam, Raghavendra Selvan, Kirsten M. Ø. Jensen

items.title: Cyclic Block Copolymers via Ring Expansion Metathesis Polymerization
items.abstract: Cyclic block copolymers are a captivating class of macromolecules with the potential for advanced materials applications due to their distinctive self-assembly behavior. Ring expansion metathesis polymerization (REMP) is a promising method towards such high molar mass cyclic polymers, but uncontrolled intermolecular ring-transfer processes have precluded its extension to cyclic block copolymers synthesis. As a result, the synthesis of cyclic block copolymers remains exceedingly rare. In this work, we utilize newfound living characteristics of REMP with cyclic Ru-benzylidene initiator Pyr-CB6 to develop novel block copolymerization methodology. Using an operationally simple sequential monomer-addition strategy followed by thermally triggered intramolecular backbiting, we produce cyclic multiblock copolymers of low dispersity ( 1.2) and high yields (up to 97%). Mechanistic analyses elucidate the delicate role that pyridine plays in the polymerization process. As a metathesis inhibitor, pyridine makes intermolecular ring-transfer prohibitively slow, but permits intramolecular backbiting when triggered. Overall, this study demonstrates the power of REMP with Pyr-CB6 as a vehicle towards a diverse future of cyclic block copolymer materials and applications.
items.authors: Lucy P Miller, Matthew R Golder

items.title: Orthonym: verified IUPAC names for chemical structures in the wild
items.abstract: Chemical structures can be named systematically, and the 2013 IUPAC recommendations define one preferred name for each. For most of history, only a specially trained chemist or dedicated closed software tools could generate a correct, systematic molecule name from a chemical structure. Published neural structure-to-name translators can produce a fluent name for the wrong molecule. Here we present Orthonym: a generator of verified IUPAC names for chemical structures. This open, deterministic, rule-based generator emits a name only after verifying that it correctly describes the input structure. OPSIN reads back each candidate name, and the InChIKey of the parsed structure must equal that of the input; otherwise, the engine declines to name. On 2.2 million selected molecules from ChEBI, QM9, PubChem and ZINC22, it named 97.37% correctly and emitted no name for the wrong molecule. Orthonym is available under the MIT licence as a Python package and a web application.
items.authors: Kohulan Rajan, Achim Zielesny, Christoph Steinbeck

items.title: Liquid State 31P NMR as a Tool to Leverage the Understanding of Reconstituted Milk Systems
items.abstract: The objective of this work was to establish the peak assignment in liquid state 31P NMR of milk systems and investigate the method as a tool to identify di!erences in casein micelles as consequence of di!erent processing history. Suspensions of milk protein concentrate with removal of casein micelles by EDTA addition and ultra-centrifugation were analyzed by liquid state 31P NMR and compared with the original suspensions. Moreover, 1H-31P total correlation spectroscopy NMR was applied to di!erentiate between peaks from phosphoserines and inorganic phosphate in dairy systems. The results provide direct evidence that the signals observed in liquid-state 31P NMR of milk systems originate from phosphoserine residues in soluble caseins and inorganic phosphate in the serum phase, thereby resolving conflicting assignments reported in previous studies. Furthermore, it is demonstrated that liquid state 31P NMR is able to quantitatively di!erentiate the native amount of inorganic phosphate in the serum phase in suspensions of milk protein concentrate and skim milk. In light of the crucial importance of the calcium phosphate equilibrium between milk serum and casein micelles for understanding the casein micelle structure and its changes, liquid state 31P NMR shows potential as a suitable technique to get a better understanding of how processing a!ect the mineral equilibrium in casein micelles.
items.authors: Pernille Koch, Dennis W. Juhl, Kirsten G. Malmos, Thomas Vosegaard

items.title: Azobenzene-Mediated Reversible Conformational Switching in 9,9′-Bifluorenylidene-Based Molecular Machines
items.abstract: Intrinsically dynamic molecules offer attractive building blocks for molecular machines, yet controlling their conformational motion with external stimuli remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we report Azo–BF–Azo, a photoresponsive molecular machine in which an intrinsically dynamic 9,9′-bifluorenylidene (BF) core is coupled to two visible-light-responsive tetra-orthofluorinated azobenzene (Azo) units that act as molecular actuators. Irradiation at 525 nm induces trans-to-cis photoisomerization of the Azo units, accompanied by a shift of the BF framework from the closed toward the open conformation, whereas irradiation at 456 nm reverses Azo isomerization and restores the BF-closed state over time. DFT calculations reveal that the extended trans-Azo units favor intramolecular π–π interactions that stabilize the closed BF conformation, while their conversion to the folded cis state disrupts these interactions and alters the steric environment surrounding the BF core. Variable-temperature NMR spectroscopy provides experimental support for the role of these intramolecular interactions in regulating the BF conformational equilibrium. The photoinduced state additionally undergoes spontaneous thermal relaxation, recovering approximately 65% of the initial state. Together, these results demonstrate that local photoisomerization of peripheral Azo actuators can reshape the conformational landscape of an intrinsically dynamic BF core through the cooperative modulation of steric and intramolecular π–π interactions. This work provides a strategy for converting intrinsic molecular dynamics into externally programmable motion and establishes a design principle for constructing integrated molecular machines in which one type of molecular motion regulates another.
items.authors: Sohail Mahajan, Reese Rich, Lin Jiao, Duhan Zhang, Wendu Ding, Jinjia Xu

items.title: Neural Kinetics: LEARNING KINETICS AS TRANSPORT IN COMPOSITIONAL SPACE
items.abstract: Complex bio-derived and fossil mixtures contain thousands of molecules whose individual structures and reaction pathways cannot be fully resolved, making conventional mechanism-based kinetic modelling impractical. A reaction network detailed enough to describe every formula-level transformation would contain far more reactions and parameters than the available data can constrain. We propose to overcome this limitation by representing mixtures directly as abundance fields on a compositional grid indexed by molecular descriptors, specifically carbon number (#C) and double-bond equivalent (DBE), and by learning a time-conditioned, chemistry-informed operator that maps the initial composition to predict a later state. The evolution rates of the chemical space are learned by a two-dimensional Fourier neural operator (FNO) acting jointly on a set of heteroatom classes, with normalized time and compositional coordinates appended as input channels. Because experimental data are limited, we enlarge the training set with synthetic trajectories generated from the measured samples, pre-train on this ensemble, and then calibrate a small subset of parameters on the measured distributions. We tested the framework on a case of oxidation of a complex hydrocarbon mixture that is tracked by FTICR-MS over sixty seconds of reaction. On an independent sample the framework, that we named NeuralKinetics, reproduced the measured endpoint class composition within a mean absolute error of approximately one percent and arranged the heteroatom classes correctly on the compositional grid. The second test was an entirely different system: litter decomposition in a peatland warming experiment, also followed by FTICR-MS but over two years. The developed operator accurately predicted the endpoint class composition of the held-out sample proving that the framework is flexible enough to adapt to diverse reactive systems.
items.authors: Paolo Guida, Naydu Zambrano Urrutia, Elia Colleoni, Shekhar R Kulkarni, Kevin Van Geem, William L. Roberts

items.title: Self-Assembled 3,4,9,10-Perylenetetracarboxylic Dianhydride is a Molecular Graphite
items.abstract: Viable organic charge storage materials must display rapid cation insertion. Typically, these materials are composed of monomers that undergo slow outer-sphere electron transfer coupled to significant bond rearrangement. Here we show that 3,4,9,10-perylenetetracarboxylic dianhydride (PTCDA) self-assembles into an organic material that undergoes graphite-like cation insertion-coupled electron transfer rather than forming a radical anion or an enolate, as previously thought. This charge storage pathway is enabled by a semiconducting band structure, coincident with cation insertion between self-assembled PTCDA molecules. Based on these results, we propose that self-assembled PTCDA is best thought of as a synthetically tunable “molecular graphite” that combines the best features of molecules with the rapid insertion pathways of traditional intercalation solids.
items.authors: Jaeyoung Lee, Nuren Lara, Tyler Case, Carrie Donley, Natalie Druffner, Nathaniel Yeboah

items.title: Revealing Solvent-free Solid-fed Aerosol Flame Technique to Synthesize Copper Oxide Deposited on Ceria Catalyst for Efficient CO Oxidation Applications
items.abstract: Developing efficient technologies for CO oxidation is an urgent priority in environmental catalysis. Copper oxide deposited on cerium oxide (CuO/CeO 2 ) has attracted considerable attention as a promising non-precious-metal catalyst for low-temperature CO oxidation. Furthermore, aerosol process emerged as a scalable route to engineer CuO/CeO 2 with tailored structures and interfacial properties, however, popular vapor-fed and liquid-fed aerosol flame approaches remain constrained by precursor requirements (vapor-fed: sufficient vapor pressure; liquid-fed: precursor solubility or dispersibility in carrier solvents). Here, for the first time, we introduce solid-fed aerosol flame synthesis (SAFS) as a single-step, solvent-free route to synthesize heterostructured CuO/CeO 2 catalysts. Through selective vaporization of Cu 2 O followed by heterogeneous nucleation onto solid CeO 2 particles, SAFS produces a well-defined architecture of CuO nanoparticles intimately deposited on CeO 2 supports. By varying the flame conditions and Cu loading, we systematically investigate their effects on particle formation, interfacial properties, and catalytic performance. The highest performance catalyst, synthesized at 2 L/min-CH 4 flame with 2 wt.% Cu 2 O, exhibits the highest CO oxidation activity, achieving a CO oxidation rate of 13.73 mLCO/min·gcat and a turnover frequency of 0.026 s -1 at 120 ºC. This enhanced performance, compared to other as-prepared CuO/CeO 2 samples, arises from an optimal balance between oxygen vacancy generation and metal-support interaction achieved during the SAFS process. Here, oxygen vacancy generation is favored under fuel-rich conditions, whereas metal-support interaction decreases with CeO 2 sublimation and CuO nanoparticle sintering under elevated combustion enthalpy. These findings advance the fundamental understanding of flame-based synthesis and provide a scalable route toward high-performance, cost-effective catalysts for environmental remediation.
items.authors: Tung Van Pham, Tomoyuki Hirano, Izuki Maruhashi, Eka Lutfi Septiani, Kiet Le Anh Cao, Takashi Ogi

items.title: Wireless Bipolar Electrochemistry for Organic Electrosynthesis: Principles, Mechanistic Insights, and Emerging Autonomous Systems
items.abstract: Wireless bipolar electrochemistry (BPE) has emerged as a powerful platform for organic electrosynthesis, enabling redox transformations on electrically floating conductors without direct electrical wiring. Through electric-field-induced polarization, bipolar electrodes simultaneously promote spatially separated oxidation and reduction reactions, offering unique opportunities for reaction design, miniaturized reactor architectures, parallel processing, and sustainable chemical synthesis. Recent years have witnessed significant advances in both exogenous and endogenous bipolar electrochemical systems, expanding the scope of wireless electrosynthesis to asymmetric transformations, flow chemistry, low-electrolyte conditions, autonomous microreactors, and self-propelled electrochemical systems. This review critically examines the fundamental principles governing bipolar electrochemistry, recent developments in organic synthesis, and emerging diagnostic methodologies, including split bipolar electrodes and electrochemiluminescence-based imaging, which have substantially improved mechanistic understanding of charge transport, polarization phenomena, and reaction control. The advantages and limitations of wireless bipolar systems are evaluated in comparison with conventional electrolysis, highlighting challenges associated with reaction selectivity, scalability, energy efficiency, and quantitative electrochemical characterization. Finally, future opportunities involving advanced materials, operando analytical techniques, artificial intelligence-assisted optimization, and continuous-flow processing are discussed. Collectively, these developments position wireless bipolar electrochemistry as a promising enabling technology for next-generation sustainable electrosynthesis and autonomous electrochemical manufacturing.
items.authors: Sadia Rani, Najoua Sbei, Afshan Ramzan, Seyfeddine Rahali, Zia ul Haq, Nisar Ahmed

items.title: Assessing the state of the art in ADMET prediction: Lessons from the OpenADMET-ExpansionRx community blind challenge
items.abstract: Computational blind challenges are essential for advancing drug discovery, especially in research areas with limited public data, such as absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, toxicity (ADMET) prediction. In this paper, we present the results of our latest community blind challenge, organized in collaboration with Expansion Therapeutics (ExpansionRx). Participants were tasked with predicting nine distinct ADMET endpoints routinely evaluated during lead optimization of compounds in drug discovery programs. Following unprecedented engagement from the global community, this challenge provided valuable insights into the state of the art in machine learning for ADMET modeling. Evaluating submissions against a realistic, challenging dataset from active ExpansionRx drug discovery programs revealed that message-passing neural networks and chemical foundation models dominated among the top performers. Furthermore, the results highlighted the power of proprietary industry datasets and a critical need to optimize predictive workflows for different endpoints independently via multitasking and task-affinity grouping. We also demonstrate how hosting our open-source blind challenge infrastructure on a flexible platform like Hugging Face was pivotal for driving community engagement and visibility. Ultimately, blind challenges supported by robust infrastructure, widespread dissemination, and rigorous post-challenge analysis are fundamental to maximizing the utility of public data releases. We anticipate that these community benchmarks will continue to drive the advancement of ADMET models, enabling their deployment in both early- and late-stage drug discovery.
items.authors: Maria A. Castellanos, Hugo MacDermott-Opeskin, Jon Ainsley, Jonathan A. Swain, Sean Colby, Devany West

items.title: “Head-cut” 2DLC–HRMS (RPLC → HILIC) enhancing non-targeted chemical coverage in environmental exposomics.
items.abstract: Chemical coverage remains a major limitation in environmental non-target analysis (NTA), as conventional one-dimensional liquid chromatography (1D-LC) provides incomplete retention and separation across the broad physicochemical space encountered in complex samples. Here, we developed an online “head-cut” two-dimensional liquid chromatography–high-resolution tandem mass spectrometry (2DLC–HRMS/MS) approach combining reversed-phase liquid chromatography (RPLC) and hydrophilic interaction liquid chromatography (HILIC), using a dual-trap system combining porous graphitic carbon and trimodal ion-exchange sorbents, to recover complementary regions of environmental chemical space within a single analysis. Trapping and modulation were first evaluated using a representative set of contaminants of emerging concern (CECs), evidencing that the combined complementary trapping materials achieves quantitative transfer (40-100%) of chemically diverse polar and mobile analytes to HILIC. Feature-based NTA performance of the optimized 2DLC method was comparatively evaluated in river water and effluent wastewater and compared with the corresponding 1D-HILIC and 1D-RPLC. “Head-cut” 2DLC yielded approximately 2.3–2.6-fold more blank-corrected ESI(+) and ESI(−) features than either individual 1D separation. Beyond feature level coverage, DIA componentization demonstrated that precursor-associated MS/MS information increased and successfully distributed across both 2DLC chromatographic domains. Fragment Ambiguity Score (FAS) analysis of ESI(+) data further confirmed the occurrence of low-ambiguity, structurally informative fragments within the expanded separation space. These results demonstrate that wide-interaction recovery of the RPLC blind spot can extend measurable chemical space and access to fragmentation information relevant for structural annotation, supporting “head-cut” RPLC→HILIC–HRMS/MS as a promising strategy for increasing chemical coverage in environmental NTA.
items.authors: Lapo Renai, Guylain. T. A. Cuiper, Viktoriia Turkina, Aleksandra Chojnacka, Saer Samanipour, Andrea F. G. Gargano

items.title: Agentic Paper: From Tacit Expertise to AI-Ready Scientific Data and Knowledge Corpora
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) for domain science demands large, well-structured training corpora that integrate experimental data with not only explicit knowledge but also tacit expertise underlying scientific decisions. However, the tacit knowledge regarding practical reasoning, assumptions, failed attempts, parameter choices, and interpretive judgment is often held by authors and unpublished, hindering its use for AI development. Here, we propose Agentic Paper, a large language model (LLM)-enabled, author-curated scientific publishing framework that organizes these resources into a structured Agentic Paper package accessible through LLM-based interfaces, enabling the integration of connected, AI-ready data, explicit knowledge, and tacit expertise. Within Agentic Paper, the LLM serves as an interactive reasoning and orchestration layer that connects knowledge content with raw and processed data, figures, methodological details, metadata, code, and author-provided interpretation. Case studies in materials synthesis and characterization demonstrate how the LLM-enabled framework supports questioning, data visualization and inspection, numerical verification, and preparation of AI-ready datasets. By combining author-based organization of scientific data and knowledge, Agentic Paper provides a scalable pathway toward provenance-rich training corpora and more reliable AI-enabled scientific workflows.
items.authors: Luke Schneider, Ganesh Narasimha, Sumner B. Harris, Ralph Bulanadi, Asraful Haque, Rama Vasudevan

items.title: Excited-State Intramolecular Proton Transfer Dynamics with Neural Network Potentials and Nuclear Quantum Effects
items.abstract: Excited-state intramolecular proton transfer is a prototypical ultrafast process that forms the foundation for many chemical and biological phenomena and is highly sensitive to changes in the underlying potential energy landscape. Here, we develop neural network potentials for 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline that describe ground- and excited-state dynamics with near ab initio accuracy. These neural network potentials enable efficient sampling of the proton transfer coordinate and incorporation of nuclear quantum effects through path-integral molecular dynamics. The free energy profiles show that excited-state intramolecular proton transfer proceeds on a largely barrierless excited-state surface, with nuclear quantum effects reducing and smoothing the residual barrier. Non-equilibrium simulations yield an average proton transfer time of ~11.5 fs for quantum hydrogen, consistent with experiment, and reveal a clear isotope effect, with slower dynamics for deuterium and classical nuclei. Mechanistic analysis identifies transient proton donor–acceptor contraction as the key enabling coordinate, while the proton crosses the midpoint prior to reaching the minimum of this coordinate, indicating a dynamically driven transfer. Subtle changes in the conjugated backbone precede proton transfer, reflecting early electronic reorganization and coherent coupling between proton motion and backbone vibrations. Bond-length alternation and vibrational coherence analysis reveal isotope-dependent coherence loss, with deuteration producing stronger damping and more localized proton/backbone dynamics relative to hydrogen. These results establish neural network potential-based approaches as an effective framework for simulating excited-state proton transfer with explicit nuclear quantum effects.
items.authors: Axel Gomez, Amke Nimmrich, Victor M. Freixas, Chenghao Zhang, Shaul Mukamel, Munira Khalil

items.title: Dynamic Parameter Screening for Accelerated Mechanistic Analysis
items.abstract: Mechanistic studies are essential for the continued advancement of the chemical sciences however; classical approaches remain laborious and material intensive. Graphical reaction analysis techniques such as RPKA and VTNA have substantially reduced this burden, yet the time and resources required to comprehensively study increasingly complex reactions remain high. Medium- and high-throughput batch and flow kinetic methods have been developed to further streamline data acquisition, but their widespread adoption is limited by the need for specialized equipment or expertise. Here we introduce dynamic parameter screening (DPS), in which a single batch reaction is monitored continuously while sequential reagent and catalyst additions are used to probe kinetic impacts of multiple species within one experimental setup. Using the palladium-catalyzed Kumada–Tamao–Corriu cross-coupling as a model system, we compared DPS with traditional one-factor-at-a-time approach across three catalytic systems (PdCl 2 (dppf)·CH 2 Cl 2 , PEPPSI-iPr, and XPhos Pd G2). DPS afforded essentially identical qualitative and quantitative (kinetic modeling) conclusions except for the case of XPhos Pd G2. This latter system exhibited multiple kinetic regimes where the traditional approach revealed the global impact of reagent concentrations, whereas DPS provided complementary, higher-resolution insight into reagent effects within a specific kinetic regime. The insights obtained from DPS guided a simple slow-dosing strategy that markedly improved reaction rates even at reduced catalyst loadings. DPS therefore provides a practical, low-barrier route to high-resolution kinetic information that is fully compatible with conventional modeling, broadening access to mechanistic understanding in resource-limited settings.
items.authors: Dylan J. Pyle, Finn Bork, Wesley McNutt, Ekaterina Trushina, Joshua S. Derasp, Sara M. Guzman

items.title: Drop-in Silver Nanogap−Cellulose Concentrator for Surface-Enhanced Raman Monitoring of Water Contaminants
items.abstract: Organic contaminants in natural waters threaten ecosystems and human health, motivating integrated strategies for trace-level monitoring. Although surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) offers molecular specificity and trace-level sensitivity, many platforms require separate preconcentration, provide limited control over analyte delivery to plasmonic hot spots, and lose performance in complex water matrices. Here, a poly(ether-block-amide) (PEBAX)-coated Ag nanogap–cellulose concentrator is reported, coupling self-driven interfacial enrichment with Raman readout through an amphiphilic, chemically heterogeneous, mixed-polarity interface. The engineered interface enabled charge-diverse partitioning of cationic and anionic molecular probes down to 10 -10 M across a broad pH range. Relative to the uncoated sensor, interfacial enrichment coupled to Ag nanogaps lowered SERS detection limits by up to 3,100-fold, reaching 1.1 × 10 -11 M for crystal violet and 2.3 × 10 -9 M for methyl orange. In untreated tap and lake water, the coated sensor resolved crystal violet and methyl orange fingerprints that were weak or variable on the uncoated sensor and identified acetamiprid and thymol within 30 min. These results show that coupling interfacial concentration with nanogap-mediated molecular readout establishes an integrated route for passive monitoring of trace contaminants in complex water matrices.
items.authors: Jonghyun Shin, Young Jun Kim, Yaprak Özbakir, Tzu-Chiao Wei, Cho-Hee Yang, Jiwoo Ko

items.title: Towards Environmentally Friendly Removal of Acrylate-Based Impregnation from Commercial Carbon Fiber Roving
items.abstract: Carbon fibers face a growing use in industry due to their exceptional mechanical and light-weight properties. Particularly they are used as carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) in lightweight mobility, wind turbines and as concrete reinforcements to create light-weight and durable structural components. To fully enable their environmentally friendly use, full life cycles and end-of-life scenarios have to be developed. Therefore, energyand cost-effective carbon fiber retrieval from polymer impregnated commercial samples needs to be investigated. In this study, we investigate a commercially available CFRP roving with an industrial acrylate-based impregnation, commonly used in construction as concrete reinforcements. The impact of several chemical solvents was assessed identifying acetic acid as a highly effective and environmentally friendly agent. To further reduce the concentration of acetic acid, electrochemical dissolution was tested where the carbon fiber was used as a working electrode in an electrochemical cell. Applying a voltage as low as 1.5 V vs. Ag|AgCl, the acetic acid concentration required to dissolve the polymer could be reduced by 33% compared to pure chemical treatment, while the tensile strength of the carbon fiber was maintained.
items.authors: Stefan Röher, Julius Scheel, Alexandra Apel, Stella Welzel, Lissy Flechsig, Christina Scheffler

items.title: Spins Afar - Long-Range Pulse Dipolar EPR Spectroscopy Uncovers Curvature in TRIM25’s Coiled Coil
items.abstract: Pulse Dipolar Electron Paramagnetic Resonance Spectroscopy (PDS) is a powerful method for determining nanometer distances in biomolecular systems. This methodology has been successfully used to validate structure hypotheses and to identify disorder. However, inherent distance limitations are under-explored. Many challenging biomolecular applications require long distance information, driving the need for a benchmarking study. We demonstrate distances up to 10.5 nm in TRIM25 reliably extracted from data obtained under standard sample conditions. By protein perdeuteration accurate distance measurements up to 17.3 nm were enabled.
