items.title: Towards Sustainable Mine Restoration: Environmental Safety Assessment of Phosphorus Migration Following Sewage Sludge Compost Application to Abandoned Phosphate Mines in Southwestern China
items.abstract: Repurposing waste-derived organic amendments for degraded land restoration supports the transition toward a circular economy, yet the associated environmental risks must be rigorously evaluated to ensure long-term sustainability. Sewage sludge compost (SSC) is a promising soil amendment for the ecological restoration of abandoned phosphate-mine sites (APMSs). However, SSC application may alter phosphorus (P) migration and release, thereby posing a risk of secondary pollution that could undermine the sustainability of mine reclamation efforts. Here, dynamic leaching-column experiments simulating three years of natural rainfall infiltration were conducted to investigate P-release characteristics under different fertilization scenarios, including application rate, application method, and compost maturity. Ecological risk was evaluated using a modified phosphorus pollution index (PPI), and the likely mechanisms governing P leaching and release in APMS soils were explored. Dissolved reactive P was the predominant released form in all treatments, accounting for 67.9–85.6% of total released P. Increasing the SSC application rate reduced the cumulative total phosphorus (TP) release ratio (on a soil TP content basis) from 0.0348% in the unfertilized control to 0.0264–0.0299%. Deep full-profile incorporation within the upper 20 cm of APMS soil and subsurface application reduced TP release by 36.8% and 34.1%, respectively, relative to shallow full-profile incorporation within the upper 10 cm of APMS soil. Primary sewage sludge compost (SSC*) controlled P release only when cumulative rainfall infiltration was ≤669 mm; by the third year, the ecological risk increased from slight to the severe-pollution level. SSC applied at 120 t ha−1 under the shallow full-profile fertilization mode reduced the PPI of APMS1 and APMS2 by 30.8–44.8% and 5.6–12.3%, respectively. P dissolution was positively associated with Ca release. Humic substances likely formed larger, less mobile, non-rigid colloidal complexes through Ca2+ bridging with carboxyl and phenolic groups, thereby immobilizing phosphate. These findings under the experimental conditions provide a scientifically grounded technical basis for the subsequent environmentally safe and sustainable use of SSC as a waste-to-resource strategy in APMS reclamation, contributing to the sustainable management of both municipal solid waste streams and degraded mining landscapes.
items.authors: Guangxia Qi, Xiaomin He, Jin Zha, Yufeng Jia, Wenhua Jia, Jianguo Liu

items.title: High-Temperature Corrosion in Biomass and Waste-to-Energy Boilers: Mechanisms, Materials and Mitigation Strategies
items.abstract: Biomass and waste contain elevated concentrations of chlorine and alkali metals that promote the problem of high-temperature chlorine corrosion in power boilers. The results are rapid metal loss, increased maintenance costs, and reduced operational availability. This review paper provides a comprehensive overview of the high-temperature chlorine corrosion in biomass- and waste-fired boilers. The occurrence and chemical speciation of chlorine in these fuels are discussed together with its transformation during thermal conversion. Particular attention is devoted to the mechanisms of active oxidation, the role of ash deposits and their chemistry. The corrosion performance of conventional boiler steels, nickel-based alloys, and protective coatings is evaluated. Laboratory investigation methods, including gravimetric measurement and microstructural characterization are reviewed alongside recent advances in computational modelling, such as thermodynamic equilibrium calculations and computational fluid dynamics. The review shows that corrosion severity is governed by the coupled effects of chlorine speciation, alkali metals, deposit chemistry, temperature, combustion conditions, and material properties. Advanced alloys and protective coatings can substantially improve corrosion resistance, but cannot completely eliminate degradation under prolonged exposure. The analysis also indicates that effective corrosion mitigation requires a combination of fuel modification, combustion optimization, deposit control, appropriate material selection, and surface engineering.
items.authors: Izabella Maj, Paweł Łój

items.title: Growth Hormone Deficiency and Systemic Metabolic Remodeling: Insights from Metabolomics and Lipidomics
items.abstract: Growth hormone (GH) deficiency (GHD) is a systemic endocrine–metabolic disorder affecting growth, body composition, substrate handling, and cardiometabolic health. Clinical evaluation relies primarily on GH stimulation testing and circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), but these measures incompletely reflect downstream tissue-level consequences of impaired GH bioactivity. Metabolomic and lipidomic profiling provide systems-level approaches for characterizing these consequences. Evidence from experimental models and human studies implicates coordinated alterations in amino-acid turnover, mitochondrial and central energy metabolism, fatty-acid handling, and lipid remodeling, consistent with disrupted substrate exchange across GH-responsive tissues. These signatures are influenced by sex, developmental stage, adiposity, nutritional state, treatment exposure, and analytical platform, limiting the interpretation of individual metabolites as universal biomarkers. In this review, we integrate current metabolomic and lipidomic evidence with established GH biology, including temporal and sex-dependent signaling, tissue-specific metabolic actions, and responses to GH replacement. We further evaluate the potential of metabolic signatures for biological phenotyping, treatment-response assessment, and pharmacodynamic monitoring. Current evidence supports metabolomics and lipidomics as promising functional readouts of altered GH action, but not yet as validated diagnostic tools. Progress toward clinical translation will require standardized study designs, longitudinal sampling, sex- and development-aware analyses, harmonized analytical workflows, and independent validation in well-characterized cohorts.
items.authors: Sarmed Al-Samerria, Sally Radovick

items.title: From ESG Commitment to Sustainable Construction Practices: Evidence from an Emerging European Market
items.abstract: This study examines the relationship between ESG integration and sustainable construction practices in the Bulgarian construction sector. The analysis is based on 143 valid responses from representatives of construction companies operating in Bulgaria. The study employed descriptive statistics and comparative analysis based on enterprise size, as well as correlation and regression analysis. The average index for ESG integration is 3.44, and for sustainable construction practices, it is 3.40. Management commitment, social policies, safety, energy efficiency, and waste management are more developed. Reporting, circular practices, green certification, and carbon control remain less institutionalized. A positive correlation was found between the two indices (r = 0.615; 95% CI [0.501; 0.708]; p 0.001). The results obtained do not allow for the establishment of a cause-and-effect relationship between the two.
items.authors: Kiril Luchkov, Kiril Anguelov
items.category_raw: Journal of Risk and Financial Management

items.title: The Impact of Sentiment Integration on Algorithmic Trading Performance: A Systematic Review of Multi-Modal Machine Learning Architectures
items.abstract: Traditional algorithmic trading relies heavily on structured financial data, but in contemporary high-density information environments, this uni-modal approach is becoming insufficient. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the impact of integrating sentiment analysis from financial news and social media on algorithmic trading performance. I conducted a systematic literature review encompassing 80 primary empirical studies published between 2012 and 2026. The findings demonstrate that integrating textual signals with market data consistently enhances risk-adjusted returns, improving Sharpe ratios by 20–60% and reducing maximum drawdowns by up to 49.6% compared to price-only baselines. However, the informational value of sentiment is highly state-dependent, yielding significant predictive advantages primarily during high-volatility regimes and market crises. Furthermore, domain-specific transformer models (e.g., FinBERT, LLaMA) substantially outperform traditional lexicon-based methods. Despite these performance gains, the operational value of sentiment integration must be evaluated against realistic transaction costs and subjected to rigorous out-of-sample validation to guard against overfitting. I conclude that utilizing sentiment analysis as a complementary risk filter, rather than a primary signal amplifier, significantly improves strategy stability. Implementing multi-modal data fusion strongly supports building resilient trading systems.
items.authors: Krzysztof Podgórski

items.title: Infections Following Skin Graft Surgery in Australia: Incidence, Graft Type and Anatomical Site Associations and Microbiology
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Infection following skin grafting can compromise graft take and prolong hospitalisation, but contemporary data describing infection incidence, microbiology and graft-specific associations are limited. We aimed to determine the incidence and microbiology of microbiologically confirmed postoperative skin graft infection, examine associations with graft type and anatomical site and describe antimicrobial prescribing practices. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 977 skin graft procedures performed in 770 patients at two regional hospitals in New South Wales, Australia, between July 2021 and August 2024. Infection was defined as a clinician-diagnosed postoperative skin graft infection with microbiological confirmation of a pathogenic organism. Associations between graft type/site and infection were explored using patient-clustered modified Poisson regression. Patient comorbidities and wound-contamination status were not consistently available and were not analysed as covariates. Results: A total of 66 microbiologically confirmed infections occurred among 977 procedures (6.8%; 95% CI 5.3–8.5%). Median length of stay was longer in infected than non-infected cases (34 vs. 3 days; p 0.001). Split-thickness grafts involving the foot, toe and extensive granulating areas had higher observed infection incidence, while full-thickness nasal grafts had lower observed incidence; subgroup estimates were imprecise. Staphylococcus aureus (47.0%) and Pseudomonas aeruginosa (22.7%) were the predominant organisms. In the nested antimicrobial audit of 119 encounters involving 116 patients, peri-operative prophylaxis and postoperative antibiotic prescribing were common. Conclusions: This Australian cohort provides contemporary estimates of microbiologically confirmed infection following skin grafting and identifies graft type/site patterns that may inform future prospective investigation. Interpretation is limited by the retrospective design, microbiological confirmation requirement, sparse subgroup events and unavailable patient- and wound-level confounders; therefore, the observed associations should not be interpreted as independent risk factors or evidence for specific preventive or treatment strategies.
items.authors: Semun Galimam, Naleesha Habib, Madhumitha Sangeetham Krishnan Asokumar, Ruchir Chavada
items.title_zh: 澳大利亚皮肤移植手术后感染的发生率及其相关因素研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：皮肤移植术后感染可能影响移植物成活率并延长住院时间，但关于感染发生率、微生物学及移植物特定关联的现代数据有限。本研究旨在确定微生物学确认的术后皮肤移植感染的发生率及微生物学特征，探讨与移植物类型和解剖部位的关联，并描述抗菌药物的处方实践。方法：我们对2021年7月至2024年8月在澳大利亚新南威尔士州两家地区医院进行的977例皮肤移植手术进行了回顾性队列研究。感染定义为临床诊断的术后皮肤移植感染，并有病原体的微生物学确认。在患者聚类的修正泊松回归中探讨了移植物类型/部位与感染之间的关联。结果：在977例手术中，共发生66例微生物学确认的感染（6.8%；95% CI 5.3–8.5%）。感染病例的中位住院天数显著长于非感染病例（34天对3天；p 0.001）。涉及足部、脚趾及广泛肉芽组织区域的分层皮肤移植物感染发生率较高，而全层鼻部移植物的感染率较低。
items.l1_lead: 在澳大利亚的皮肤移植手术中，微生物学确认的感染发生率为6.8%，且感染与移植物类型及解剖部位密切相关，感染病例的住院时间显著延长。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨澳大利亚新南威尔士州两家地区医院中皮肤移植术后感染的发生率及其相关因素。皮肤移植术后感染可能会影响移植物的成活率并延长患者的住院时间，但目前关于这一领域的现代数据相对有限。研究对象为2021年7月至2024年8月期间进行的977例皮肤移植手术，研究通过回顾性队列分析，定义感染为临床诊断的术后皮肤移植感染，并伴有病原体的微生物学确认。

研究结果显示，在977例手术中，共发生66例微生物学确认的感染，感染发生率为6.8%（95% CI 5.3–8.5%）。感染病例的中位住院天数显著长于非感染病例，分别为34天和3天（p < 0.001），表明感染对患者住院时间的影响显著。此外，研究还发现，涉及足部、脚趾及广泛肉芽组织区域的分层皮肤移植物感染发生率较高，而全层鼻部移植物的感染率则较低。这一结果提示，移植物的类型和解剖部位与术后感染的发生存在一定的关联性。

综上所述，本研究提供了关于皮肤移植术后感染的现代数据，强调了感染对患者住院时间的影响，并揭示了不同移植物类型和解剖部位对感染发生率的影响，为临床实践提供了重要的参考依据。

items.title: Plasma Vitamin C, 25-Hydroxyvitamin D, and the Lactate-to-Albumin Ratio at PICU Admission in Survivors and Non-Survivors of Phoenix-Defined Pediatric Sepsis and Septic Shock: An Exploratory Prospective Cohort Study
items.abstract: Background: Vitamin C, 25-hydroxyvitamin D (25[OH]D), and the lactate-to-albumin ratio (LAR) have been proposed as prognostic markers in sepsis. However, pediatric data are limited, and these markers have not been evaluated together in a cohort classified according to the Phoenix criteria. We quantified these markers at pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) admission and assessed their unadjusted association with mortality. Methods: This single-center prospective cohort study followed the STROBE statement. We enrolled consecutive children aged 1 month to 17 years with suspected infection and a Phoenix Sepsis Score of at least 2; septic shock required at least one cardiovascular point. Blood was sampled within 1 h of admission. We analyzed ascorbate by ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry in light-protected heparin plasma. The endpoint was pre-discharge PICU mortality. We expressed differences as Hodges–Lehmann estimates with exact 95% confidence intervals (CIs), and discrimination as the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). The five principal biomarker comparisons were subjected to Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) control. We fitted no multivariable model (11 events). Results: Of the 37 children enrolled, 33 (89.2%) had septic shock, and the mortality rate was 29.7%. Non-survivors had lower plasma vitamin C concentrations (51.1 vs. 73.8 umol/L; difference −17.0, 95% CI −28.4 to −5.7, p = 0.028, q = 0.141, AUC 0.73, 95% CI 0.55–0.90), and mortality declined across ascending vitamin C tertiles, although the gradient was not statistically significant (p = 0.058). No patient had hypovitaminosis C ( 23 umol/L). We did not detect an association between 25(OH)D, lactate, albumin, or the LAR and mortality (all p ≥ 0.18; AUC 0.50–0.64), and the LAR was collinear with lactate (rho = 0.95). The weight-for-age z-score correlated with vitamin C (rho = 0.39, p = 0.033). Conclusions: In this small cohort, non-survivors had lower plasma vitamin C concentrations within the replete range in unadjusted analysis; this difference did not persist after FDR control or in the subgroup with evaluable nutritional status, and nutritional confounding cannot be excluded. No association with mortality was detected for 25(OH)D, lactate, albumin, or the LAR. These findings are hypothesis-generating, do not establish prognostic value, and require multicenter confirmation.
items.authors: Jesús J. Martínez-García, Adrian Canizalez-Román, Ricardo Zatarain-Lopez, Marcel Antonio Cazarez-Aguilar, Martín Adrián Bolívar-Rodríguez, Luis Velazquez-Lopez
items.title_zh: PICU入院时维生素C、25-羟基维生素D与乳酸-白蛋白比率在儿童脓毒症中的研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：维生素C、25-羟基维生素D（25[OH]D）和乳酸-白蛋白比率（LAR）被提议作为脓毒症的预后标志物，但在儿童中的数据有限。本研究在儿童重症监护病房（PICU）入院时量化这些标志物，并评估其与死亡率的关联。方法：本单中心前瞻性队列研究遵循STROBE声明，招募了1个月至17岁疑似感染的儿童，Phoenix脓毒症评分至少为2；脓毒性休克需至少一项心血管评分。入院后1小时内采集血样，采用超高效液相色谱-质谱联用法分析抗坏血酸。终点为PICU出院前死亡率。结果：37名儿童中，33名（89.2%）为脓毒性休克，死亡率为29.7%。非幸存者的血浆维生素C水平较低。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，儿童脓毒症患者入院时的维生素C水平较低与死亡率相关，提示维生素C可能作为预后标志物。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨维生素C、25-羟基维生素D（25[OH]D）和乳酸-白蛋白比率（LAR）作为儿童脓毒症的预后标志物的潜在价值。研究对象为1个月至17岁之间的疑似感染儿童，入院时Phoenix脓毒症评分至少为2，且脓毒性休克患者需满足至少一项心血管评分的标准。研究采用单中心前瞻性队列设计，遵循STROBE声明，招募了37名儿童进行分析。

在入院后1小时内，研究团队采集了血样，并通过超高效液相色谱-质谱联用法分析了抗坏血酸（维生素C）的水平。结果显示，在37名参与者中，有33名（89.2%）被诊断为脓毒性休克，整体死亡率为29.7%。进一步分析发现，非幸存者的血浆维生素C水平显著低于幸存者，这提示维生素C可能与儿童脓毒症的预后存在关联。

本研究的结果表明，维生素C水平可能是儿童脓毒症患者的重要预后指标，尤其是在脓毒性休克的情况下。尽管本研究样本量较小，但其发现为进一步研究维生素C及其他生物标志物在儿童脓毒症中的作用提供了初步证据，强调了在临床实践中监测这些标志物的重要性。未来的研究需要扩大样本量，以验证这些标志物在脓毒症预后评估中的实际应用价值。

items.title: Mechanical Response and Instability of Granite with Parallel Non-Persistent Joints Under Rapid True-Triaxial Unloading: A PFC3D Numerical Study
items.abstract: Rapid excavation in deep rock masses imposes a non-proportional stress path that can destabilize jointed rock. A three-dimensional Particle Flow Code (PFC3D) true-triaxial model of granite containing two parallel non-persistent joints was used to examine the effects of joint length, joint spacing, joint dip angle, and minimum principal stress, followed by 25 joint length–dip angle combinations. The prescribed path rapidly released the minimum principal stress to zero after the major principal stress reached 50 MPa while maintaining the intermediate principal stress at 40 MPa, followed by continued axial loading to failure. In the single-factor tests, joint length caused the most systematic deterioration: post-unloading strength fell from 103.22 to 36.85 MPa as joint length increased from 5 to 45 mm, and specimens with 40–45 mm joints could no longer recover the load-bearing level at unloading onset. Joint dip angle produced a pronounced V-shaped anisotropy, with the lowest strength at 15–30°. More importantly, long joints altered when damage accumulated: 55.6–69.0% of the cracks formed before the post-unloading strength was reached were generated during rapid unloading, while the peak elastic energy-storage ratio decreased from 76.4% to 31.9%, indicating a transition toward dissipation-dominated behavior. In the factorial analysis, joint dip angle and joint length explained 61.67% and 24.32% of the variation in the composite strength–energy-storage response, respectively, and longer joints amplified the weakening associated with unfavorable intermediate dip angles. Across 85 numerical cases, low strength–energy-storage capacity coincided with high unloading-induced crack fractions and loss of post-unloading strength recovery. These results identify a coupled instability mechanism governed by rock-bridge degradation, earlier damage activation, and reduced elastic energy storage, providing a basis for recognizing unloading-sensitive joint configurations in deep excavation.
items.authors: Ziming Liu, Ying Chen, Jiadong Qiu, He Liu, Wenkai Ru

items.title: Design and Open-Water Validation of an Autonomous Underwater Robot for Physical Diver Safety Assistance
items.abstract: Diving accidents remain frequently fatal, and most stem from preventable human factors: panic, failed buoyancy control, and disorientation. Underwater human–robot interaction research has focused on observing the diver and offers little help when a diver must be pulled to safety. This paper presents the design and sea validation of NADIA, an autonomous underwater robot that combines diver guidance and following with diver-commanded physical assistance. A rear handle converts the diver’s grip into thrust and springs back to neutral on release; a diver-facing display shows depth, distance, battery state, and warnings. Six vector thrusters, with mounting angles optimized by gradient descent against drag-model thrust-ratio targets, are driven by an operational-space time-delay controller (TDC-OSF) that keeps the robot in the diver’s view; stereo vision and imaging sonar are fused for diver detection. In test-bed, tank, and sea trials, surge and heave thrusts matched design targets within 5–7%; approval-gated guidance held the robot 1–2 m from the diver with position and heading errors below 0.15 m and 3.5°; and the robot towed a diver at about 1 m/s and rose from 5 m to the surface in about 4 s. An underwater robot can thus serve as a physical safety layer for divers.
items.authors: Min-Gyu Kim, Hyungjoo Kang, Hansol Jin, Ji-Hong Li, Gun Rae Cho, Gyeongmin Kim
items.category_raw: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering

items.title: Beyond Landmark Error: Agreement Between AI-Assisted and Manual Cephalometric Tracing at the Level of Clinical Measurements: A Systematic Review
items.abstract: Background: Artificial intelligence has revolutionized the field of dentistry. This systematic review evaluated the clinical performance of artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted cephalometric tracing compared with manual or expert digital tracing. Methods: We searched the PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science databases from inception to 20 May 2026. Studies directly comparing AI-assisted tracing with manual or expert digital tracing of the same lateral cephalograms and reporting at least one clinically relevant cephalometric outcome were included in the review. Two authors independently screened records. Risk of bias was assessed using an adapted QUADAS-2 framework. A quantitative meta-analysis was planned but not performed. Findings were synthesised narratively by measurement, platform, and workflow, with reporting informed by the Synthesis Without Meta-analysis (SWiM) guideline. Results: Twenty studies were included. Direct AI-versus-reference ICCs were reported in more than three studies, but their formulations and reference procedures varied. Small average differences sometimes coexisted with wide individual limits of agreement. The numerical evidence did not establish a consistent ranking of SNA, SNB, and ANB. Conclusions: AI-assisted tracing may be useful as a clinician-verified adjunct, but its performance depends on the measurement, platform, and workflow. The evidence does not establish uniform clinical interchangeability with manual or expert digital tracing.
items.authors: Hassan Ahmed Assiri, Huda Alnami, Anwar Abdullah Alsaeed, Hana Almujthel, Zayed Assiri, Mohammed Alalmai

items.title: Board Expertise and Firm Profitability: The Moderating Roles of Product Market Competition and Institutional Quality
items.abstract: This paper investigates the association between board expertise and firm profitability. Using an international sample of 42,623 firm-year observations from 2002 to 2021, we find that firms with greater industry and financial expertise on their boards exhibit significantly higher profitability. This finding suggests that board expertise function as an important internal governance mechanism through which firms strengthen managerial oversight, improve strategic decision-making, and ultimately create shareholder value. We further show that the effectiveness of board expertise depends on the external governance environment. Specifically, the profitability-enhancing effect of board expertise is more pronounced in competitive product markets, consistent with a complementary relationship between market discipline and board-level governance. Product market competition appears to enhance the effectiveness of skilled directors in monitoring management and making strategic decisions that create shareholder value. Conversely, the positive relationship between board expertise and firm profitability is less pronounced among firms operating in countries with stronger institutional quality, consistent with a substitution view whereby effective legal systems, regulatory frameworks, investor protection, and enforcement reduce the incremental governance benefits of skilled boards.
items.authors: Rihem Soussi Fathallah, Hamza Nizar, Houssam Bouzgarrou, Naila Amara, Ahmed Hassanein
items.category_raw: Journal of Risk and Financial Management

items.title: Assessing the Small Nuclear Ribosomal Subunit (18S rRNA) as a Potential Barcoding Gene for Amphipoda (Malacostraca: Peracarida) Along with the Design of a Unique Primer Set to Target the Amphipod 18S rRNA Gene
items.abstract: The mitochondrial cytochrome oxidase I (COI) gene is frequently used as a barcoding gene for the identification of numerous taxa, including crustaceans such as amphipods. The gene’s variability, which makes it useful for barcoding, can also create primer annealing issues that can inhibit amplification and sequencing, and nuclear copies of mitochondrial DNA (NUMTs) can sometimes preferentially amplify over the mitochondrial COI target locus. The small nuclear ribosomal gene (18S rRNA) can overcome issues of amplification and sequencing as primers can be designed to target highly conserved regions, making it useful across a wide variety of taxa. Due to its conserved nature, the 18S rRNA gene has not been considered a strong candidate for barcoding. Peracarid crustaceans have an insertion within the V4 hypervariable region, and amphipods are unique amongst the peracarids with an additional insertion in the V5 hypervariable region, which could make this part of the gene large and variable enough to target for barcoding. Herein, we present three primer sets designed for Amphipoda that amplify the majority of the 18S rRNA gene, including one pair (18S450F-18S1500R) that captures the V4/V5 hypervariable regions. Analyses utilizing tree-building algorithms and two species delimitation models demonstrate the potential utility of the gene region amplified by the 18S450F-18S1500R primers for barcoding. The utility of this gene for barcoding will depend on researchers incorporating this locus into future species descriptions and phylogenetic studies.
items.authors: Thomas R. Sawicki, Andrew G. Cannizzaro, Joshua M. Sisco

items.title: Baseline Determination for Threshold-Based Interpretation and Groups of Single-Particle Aerosol Fluorescence Measurements
items.abstract: Real-time single-particle fluorescence instruments are increasingly used for bioaerosol monitoring, yet interpretation of fluorescence-positive particles depends strongly on how the baseline or threshold is defined. This study evaluates deionised water (H2O), sodium chloride (NaCl), and quartz/silica (SiO2) as low-fluorescence references for the SwisensPoleno Jupiter and examines how baseline selection influences threshold-based interpretation. Controlled reference datasets were used to characterise baseline fluorescence distributions, assess particle size effects, and define baseline-specific thresholds using a consistent mean plus three standard deviations (μ+3σ) criterion. Threshold sensitivity was also examined using the empirical 99th percentile (P99) and a robust median absolute deviation (MAD)-based approach. The three reference materials produced distinct baseline responses. NaCl generated the broadest fluorescence ranges across all excitation sources, with μ+3σ upper thresholds of approximately 52.0×10−3, 39.3×10−3, and 38.2×10−3 arbitrary units, compared with 6.6×10−3, 10.1×10−3, and 3.1×10−3 for H2O and 12.1×10−3, 9.1×10−3, and 2.6×10−3 for SiO2. Although NaCl produced larger and more variable particles, its broader response persisted within a shared 10–30 µm size interval. Applying the thresholds to representative test materials showed that baseline choice altered both the proportion of particles exceeding the low-fluorescence background and their excitation–source combination patterns, particularly for near-baseline and moderately fluorescent samples. P99 generally produced results closest to μ+3σ, whereas MAD-based thresholds produced larger changes for several baseline–source combinations, while baseline–material differences remained evident across all three approaches. Summer and winter ambient case studies showed the same baseline dependence. H2O- and SiO2-based thresholds produced broadly similar fluorescence exceedance structures, whereas NaCl-based thresholds retained fewer weakly fluorescent particles. These findings show that both baseline material and threshold definition should be reported explicitly and that the resulting categories should be interpreted as operational fluorescence exceedance patterns rather than definitive biological particle classifications.
items.authors: Sen Yan, Gemma Davis, Jason Ruane, Moisés Martínez-Bracero, Noel E. O’Connor, Jiayao Chen

items.title: A Bioinspired Insole Based on Shear-Stiffening Gel for Plantar Load Modulation: Material Characterization and a Single-Case Wearable Evaluation
items.abstract: The human foot adaptively modulates stiffness during walking to balance impact attenuation, arch support, and propulsion, but this function may decline with aging and foot deformity. This study developed a bioinspired insole (bio-insole) for passive rate-adaptive plantar load modulation by embedding shear-stiffening gel (STG) within a Dragon Skin 30 (DS30) silicone elastomer backbone. DS30-STG sandwich specimens were characterized under rate-dependent and cyclic compression. A customized prototype was then evaluated in a preliminary single-case proof-of-concept walking test involving an older adult with sarcopenia, pes cavus, and hindfoot varus tendency, using stock and rigid insoles as comparators. The DS30-STG composite exhibited rate-dependent stiffening, with the apparent compressive modulus increasing from 262.11 to 553.00 kPa as the compression speed increased from 30 to 2000 mm/min, and showed short-term repeatable responses over 100 cycles at 40% strain. Compared with the stock insole, the bio-insole was associated with higher pressure-derived plantar force and peak pressure at the heel, medial arch, and first metatarsophalangeal joint. It also showed lower measured peak electromyography amplitudes of the tibialis anterior and lateral gastrocnemius by 7.8% and 9.3%, respectively, compared with the stock insole. No large observable changes were found in sagittal-plane ankle or knee excursion. These preliminary participant-specific findings suggest that the tested DS30-STG-based insole was associated with altered regional plantar loading and lower-leg muscle activation patterns during walking. Controlled studies with larger cohorts are required to determine reproducibility, tissue-loading safety, functional benefit, and clinical relevance.
items.authors: Qingqing Zhang, Jiaming Chen, Changqiu Zhou, Ziqin Ling, Kehan Zou, Wenbo Yuan

items.title: Methanol-Free Production of Recombinant AppA Phytase in Komagataella phaffii: Evaluation of Cultivation Conditions, Bioreactor Cultivation, and Biochemical Characterization
items.abstract: Phytases are widely used as feed additives because they improve phosphorus utilization from plant-derived feed ingredients and reduce phosphorus excretion into the environment. Most recombinant AppA phytases produced in Komagataella phaffii have been obtained using methanol-inducible expression systems, whereas information on constitutive methanol-free production remains limited. In this study, Escherichia coli AppA phytase was expressed in K. phaffii under the control of the glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase promoter. Cultivation temperature and initial glucose concentration were evaluated in shake-flask cultures, while the selected conditions were assessed in a 2 L stirred-tank bioreactor. Extracellular phytase activity reached 114.17 ± 2.71 U/mL in shake flasks at 27 °C with 3% initial glucose. The K. phaffii-produced enzyme was N-glycosylated, with an apparent molecular weight of approximately 54 kDa compared with approximately 45 kDa after deglycosylation. Compared with purified rAppA-E, the rAppA-P preparation showed a lower temperature optimum, a narrower pH–activity profile, and lower apparent thermostability. In a single bioreactor run, extracellular phytase activity reached 186.81 ± 0.25 U/mL, approximately 1.6-fold higher than the maximum mean shake-flask value. These findings demonstrate constitutive, methanol-free extracellular production of AppA in K. phaffii and support further development of controlled cultivation strategies.
items.authors: Magzhan Astrakhanov, Viktoriya Popova, Kairat Baltin, Saveliy Kirillov, Bekbolat Khassenov, Saniya Aktayeva

items.title: A Comprehensive Review on Plant-Derived Proteins and Their Future Prospects in Sustainable Human Nutrition and Health Implications
items.abstract: The global food system is under pressure to shift toward protein sources that can sustain a growing population without depleting natural resources. This review discusses plant-derived proteins in the context of human nutrition, focusing on their composition, quality, biological effects, and potential for dietary use. Protein content, amino acid profiles, and digestibility differ widely across legumes, cereals, pseudocereals, oilseeds, and novel sources. Soy and potato proteins show the highest quality among plant sources under the DIAAS scoring system, approaching values typical of animal proteins. Cereal proteins are generally lower in quality, largely because they lack sufficient lysine and are less digestible. Processing methods such as heating, fermentation, enzymatic treatment, and non-thermal techniques can reduce antinutritional compounds while preserving amino acid availability. Beyond providing essential nutrients, plant proteins appear to influence appetite regulation, support muscle maintenance, improve gut health through microbial metabolites, and offer protection against several chronic conditions, including cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, and kidney dysfunction. These benefits, however, are not easily realized. Barriers related to cultivation, manufacturing, sensory properties, affordability, and regulation continue to limit their broader adoption. With appropriate processing and careful blending of complementary sources, plant-derived proteins can serve as a practical and sustainable component of human diets.
items.authors: Asma Aktar, Kishor Mazumder, Md. Sadman Hossain, Biswajit Biswas, Md. Emran Hossain, Asgar Farahnaky

items.title: Groundwater Quality and Its Relationship with Lithology in the Rhône–Mediterranean–Corsica Basin
items.abstract: This study analyses groundwater quality in the Rhône–Mediterranean–Corsica (RMC) basin using 27,741 samples collected from 7,625 sampling points and 224 groundwater bodies, covering a 34-year period (1987–2021). The objective is to quantify, using statistical and machine learning methods, the respective contributions of temporal variability, spatial variability, and lithology to the hydrochemical and microbiological composition of aquifers. The results reveal a marked dichotomy between microbiological and physico-chemical parameters. Faecal contamination (E. coli, enterococci) is dominated by a strong temporal component (33–36% of variance), whereas spatial structuring by lithology remains very limited ( lt; 11%). Conversely, major physico-chemical parameters (calcium, conductivity, sulphates, etc.) exhibit near-zero temporal variability ( lt;7%) and a spatial structuring strongly controlled by lithology, with gains in explained variance of up to 20% through lithological grouping. Linear discriminant analysis achieves an overall classification rate of 56.2%, but with wide disparities: the crystalline basement is perfectly discriminated (76%), while alluvial formations are not discriminated at all (0%), as their chemical signature is more strongly influenced by anthropogenic pressures than by lithology. Machine learning methods, particularly k-nearest neighbours (k-NN), significantly improve performance (76.2% vs. 56.2% for LDA), confirming the existence of nonlinear structures in the data. Unsupervised validation via K-means confirms the reality of the lithological signal. From an operational standpoint, these findings justify a differentiated approach to groundwater management: a geological approach for chemical parameters, and an approach based on land use and agropastoral practices for bacteriological parameters. The proposed methodology – combining PCA, HCA, nested ANOVA, LDA and machine learning – provides a transferable analytical framework applicable to other major European river basins.
items.authors: Zouhair Zeiki, Ismail Mohsine, Abderrahim Bousouis, Mouna El Jirari, Meryem Touzani, Abdoul Azize Barry

items.title: Integrated Cellular Stress Networks in Human‐Pathogenic Fungi: Evolutionary Origins, Ecological Adaptation, and Consequences for Infection
items.abstract: Fungal stress responses are frequently discussed in relation to virulence and antifungal resistance, yet most underlying systems have deeper evolutionary histories and function across diverse ecological contexts. This review integrates evolutionary, ecological, and molecular perspectives on stress adaptation in major human-pathogenic fungi. Environmental pressures, including temperature fluctuations, water and nutrient limitation, hypoxia, microbial competition, predation, and antifungal exposure, can shape stress-response capacities before or independently of human infection. We examine major molecular systems involved in fungal stress adaptation, including chaperone networks, HOG and cell-wall-integrity signaling, pH and hypoxia responses, the unfolded protein response, autophagy, redox signaling, and mitochondrial retrograde signaling. These systems interact through shared regulators and physiological outputs to maintain cellular homeostasis. Although core components are often conserved, their regulatory connections and phenotypic outputs can differ substantially among fungal lineages. During host association, these evolutionarily shaped and subsequently modified networks can support adaptation to immune, metabolic, physicochemical, and therapeutic stresses. Their contributions to antifungal tolerance and persistence should be distinguished from stable resistance. We propose that fungal pathogenicity represents one ecological context in which pre-existing and subsequently modified stress-response capacities are deployed, rather than assuming that infection-associated functions necessarily reveal their evolutionary origins.
items.authors: Takahiro Namiki, Quang Duy Trinh, Ngan Thi Kim Pham, Shun Ito, Kazuhide Takada, Shihoko Komine-Aizawa
items.title_zh: 人类致病真菌的细胞压力网络：进化起源与生态适应
items.summary_zh: 本综述探讨了人类致病真菌的压力适应机制，结合进化、生态和分子视角。环境压力如温度波动、水分和养分限制、缺氧、微生物竞争、捕食及抗真菌药物暴露，能够在感染前或独立于感染地塑造真菌的压力反应能力。我们分析了参与真菌压力适应的主要分子系统，包括伴侣蛋白网络、HOG和细胞壁完整性信号、pH和缺氧反应、未折叠蛋白反应、自噬、氧化还原信号及线粒体逆行信号。这些系统通过共享的调节因子和生理输出相互作用，以维持细胞稳态。尽管核心成分通常保守，但其调节连接和表型输出在不同真菌谱系中可能存在显著差异。这些经过进化塑造并随后修饰的网络在宿主关联过程中支持对免疫、代谢、物理化学和治疗压力的适应。其对抗真菌耐受性和持久性的贡献应与稳定性抗性区分开来。
items.l1_lead: 人类致病真菌通过进化适应多种环境压力，形成复杂的细胞压力网络，以增强对宿主免疫和治疗压力的抵抗能力。
items.l2_summary:
本综述探讨了人类致病真菌在面对环境压力时的适应机制，结合了进化、生态和分子层面的视角。研究指出，环境压力如温度波动、水分和养分限制、缺氧、微生物竞争、捕食以及抗真菌药物的暴露，能够在感染前或独立于感染的情况下塑造真菌的压力反应能力。文章分析了多个参与真菌压力适应的主要分子系统，包括伴侣蛋白网络（chaperone protein network）、高渗透性甘油（HOG）信号通路、细胞壁完整性信号、pH和缺氧反应、未折叠蛋白反应、自噬（autophagy）、氧化还原信号及线粒体逆行信号等。这些系统通过共享的调节因子和生理输出相互作用，以维持细胞的稳态。

尽管这些核心成分在不同真菌中通常是保守的，但其调节连接和表型输出在不同真菌谱系中可能存在显著差异。这些经过进化塑造并随后修饰的网络在宿主关联过程中支持真菌对免疫、代谢、物理化学和治疗压力的适应。综述强调，这些适应机制对抗真菌耐受性和持久性的贡献应与稳定性抗性（stable resistance）进行区分。通过对这些压力适应机制的深入理解，可以为未来的抗真菌治疗策略提供新的思路和方向。

items.title: On em R sub 1 /sub /em -Urysohn Spaces
items.abstract: We introduce and investigate a separation property that we call an R1-Urysohn property. A topological space (X, τ ) is called R1-Urysohn if, whenever x, y ∈ X satisfy cl x ̸= cl y, there exist disjoint open sets U, V ∈ τ such that cl x ⊆ clU and cl y ⊆ cl V. The definition is formulated in terms of closures of singleton sets, and therefore naturally interacts with the classical R0 and R1 separation axioms. We establish basic relationships with R0, R1, Hausdorff, regular, and Urysohn spaces. We prove that every Urysohn space is R1-Urysohn and that every R1 space is R1-Urysohn. Several examples are given to show that the new condition does not automatically imply the classical R1 or Hausdorff properties. We also investigate the behavior of the property under subspaces, products, continuous maps, and quotient constructions.
items.authors: Saeid Jafari

items.title: COMPASS: Temporally Consistent Topological Passing Decisions for Socially Aware Robot Navigation
items.abstract: Service robots in crowded pedestrian environments re-decide at every control cycle which side to pass a person on; when this re-decision is greedy, the passing direction can oscillate across cycles in ambiguous configurations, or the robot can freeze. Topology-aware planners bias selection toward the previously chosen class through soft costs, selection hysteresis, or consistency weights; opinion-dynamics methods make the passing side an explicit, stateful decision with deadlock-breaking guarantees; and minimum-dwell or fixed-rate selectors bound the switching rate by construction. We introduce COMPASS (COMmitment-based PASSing for Social navigation), a decision-layer planner whose commitment rule is a leaky evidence accumulator — a rectified, leaky variant of Page’s one-sided CUSUM statistic with a progress-dependent threshold — under a lexicographic safety override of the standard priority-arbitration kind. Passing classes are bound to person track IDs, a design contract that the current implementation only partly realizes. We state five properties (P1–P5); they apply standard arguments and are not new mathematics. The load-bearing one, P2, is a deterministic, pathwise lower bound on the number of control cycles between discretionary switches that follows from the accumulator rather than from a fixed dwell timer; at the default knobs its worst case is 3 cycles (0.15 s). P2 is paired with a conditional response-time bound, and P1 refines it to an exponentially small per-cycle switching probability under an i.i.d. hypothesis. In an offline harness that drives the actual decision core (5 scenarios × 50 seeds), an immediate-argmin comparator produces about 98 decision changes per encounter under ambiguous ties, whereas COMPASS produces at most one decision change in each tested encounter, as does a 0.6 s persistence (dwell) timer in that scenario; the two rules differ under transient, reversing and intermittent advantage. In a historical decision-core-only measurement, latency at K = 3 (8 classes) is p99 58.6µs and max 651.3µs (the max is about 1.30% of the 50 ms budget at 20 Hz). All comparators are internal. Closed-loop evaluation, external baselines (including a previous-class consistency-weight baseline), and user studies are not performed; they are specified as a planned-evaluation protocol. Code: https://github.com/kjungmo/compass.
items.authors: Jungmo Kang

items.title: Concept for Consistent Soil–Structure Interaction Regarding Structural Analysis
items.abstract: Soil–structure interaction (SSI) plays a decisive role in the settlement behavior of shallow foundations, where soil stiffness, structural stiffness, and load application interact in a coupled manner. While traditional SSI concepts such as the system stiffness method provide robust results for many standard cases, they often rely on simplifications that may mask important mechanisms, particularly differential settlements and their feedback on structural forces. This paper proposes a systematic approximation strategy that bridges geotechnical settlement analysis and structural assessment. Parametric studies on frame- and wall-type buildings, combined with a detailed case study, demonstrate the influence of key factors: (i) structural stiffness representation, including staged construction and time-dependent effects such as creep and cracking; (ii) load application strategies, ranging from holistic modeling to simplified approximations; and (iii) the interaction between construction sequence and soil consolidation behavior. The results highlight that 3D structural models, or at least the participating structural part, provide the most reliable settlement predictions, and that a holistic load representation is essential to capture realistic redistribution. Simplifications remain valid for simple cases, but considering stiffness reduction due to cracking and staged construction is essential for reliable long-term assessments. The proposed concept offers a transparent path for both optimization and reliable settlement prediction, without increasing geotechnical investigation efforts.
items.authors: Christian Wallner, Franz Tschuchnigg, Dirk Schlicke

items.title: AI-Augmented Digital Diagnostics in Minimally Invasive Dentistry: A Case Report on Clinically Occult Approximal Caries
items.abstract: Background: Approximal dental caries pose a persistent diagnostic challenge, as early lesions frequently remain clinically occult beneath intact enamel surfaces during routine visual–tactile inspection. This case report describes the clinical utility, limitations, and decision-making discrepancies within a multimodal digital diagnostic workflow combining intraoral radiography, near-infrared light transillumination (NILT), and deep-learning artificial intelligence (AI) radiographic analysis. Case Presentation: A 19-year-old female patient presented with provoked cold and sweet sensitivity localized to the upper left quadrant. Clinical inspection revealed visually intact accessible enamel surfaces (ICDAS 0 on tooth 25. To resolve the discrepancy between subjective symptoms and inconclusive initial visual findings, periapical radiography and NILT were performed. After the clinician-led treatment plan had been established, the radiograph was additionally processed using ClinicalAID as a parallel research analysis. Diagnostic Assessment and Management: Periapical radiography and NILT revealed approximal demineralization on teeth 24, 25, and 26. After the clinician-led treatment plan had been established, the radiograph was additionally processed with ClinicalAID as a parallel research analysis, yielding model confidence scores of 100%, 99%, and 98% for teeth 24, 25, and 26, respectively. Pre-operative therapeutic stratification remained entirely clinician-led: teeth 24 and 25 were selected for operative intervention based on provoked symptomatology and radiographic appearance of dentinal involvement, whereas tooth 26 was managed non-operatively with topical fluoridation and scheduled monitoring. Operative clinical reference assessment confirmed demineralization extending into the middle third of the dentin on tooth 25. Conclusions: High AI caries-detection confidence scores do not differentiate between lesion depth, cavitation status, or the necessity of operative intervention, as evidenced by divergent clinical pathways despite near-identical AI output scores on teeth 25 and 26. Deep-learning algorithms must function strictly as adjunctive decision-support tools within a human-in-the-loop framework (Intelligence Augmentation), with treatment planning governed by clinical symptoms, caries risk, and conventional diagnostic synthesis.
items.authors: Michal Augustín, Tomáš Siebert
items.title_zh: AI辅助数字诊断在微创牙科中的应用：隐匿邻面龋病例报告
items.summary_zh: 背景：邻面龋的早期病变常在完整的牙釉质表面下隐匿，给诊断带来挑战。本病例报告描述了一种结合口内放射影像、近红外光透照（NILT）和深度学习人工智能（AI）放射分析的多模式数字诊断工作流程的临床应用、局限性及决策差异。病例介绍：一名19岁女性患者上左侧出现冷和甜的敏感症状，临床检查显示牙齿25的牙釉质表面视觉上完好。为了解决主观症状与初步视觉发现不一致的问题，进行了根尖放射影像和NILT检查。诊断评估与管理：根尖放射影像和NILT显示牙齿24、25和26存在邻面去矿化。经过临床治疗方案的制定，放射影像还通过ClinicalAID进行平行研究分析，模型信心评分分别为100%、99%和98%。
items.l1_lead: 结合多种技术的AI辅助数字诊断能够有效识别隐匿邻面龋，提升微创牙科的诊断准确性和治疗决策。
items.l2_summary:
邻面龋的早期病变常常隐藏在完整的牙釉质表面下，给临床诊断带来了显著挑战。本文报告了一例19岁女性患者的病例，患者在上左侧牙齿出现冷和甜的敏感症状，然而临床检查显示其牙齿25的牙釉质表面视觉上完好。为了进一步探讨患者的主观症状与初步视觉发现之间的不一致，研究团队采用了多模式数字诊断工作流程，结合了口内放射影像、近红外光透照（NILT）和深度学习人工智能（AI）放射分析。

通过根尖放射影像和NILT检查，诊断评估显示患者的牙齿24、25和26存在邻面去矿化现象。这一发现为后续的临床治疗方案制定提供了重要依据。值得注意的是，放射影像还通过ClinicalAID进行平行研究分析，得出的模型信心评分分别为100%、99%和98%，显示出该AI辅助诊断工具在评估邻面龋方面的高准确性和可靠性。

尽管该多模式数字诊断工作流程在临床应用中展现出良好的效果，但仍存在一定的局限性。具体而言，AI模型的决策过程可能受到训练数据的影响，且在某些情况下，临床医生的主观判断仍然是不可或缺的。因此，结合AI技术与临床经验，将有助于提高邻面龋的诊断准确性，最终改善患者的治疗效果。

综上所述，AI辅助数字诊断在微创牙科中的应用，尤其是在隐匿邻面龋的识别和评估方面，展现出了良好的前景和潜力，为未来的牙科诊断提供了新的思路和方法。

items.title: Dracaena trifasciata and Dracaena angolensis: Phytochemistry, Pharmacological Activities, and Mechanistic Insights
items.abstract: Dracaena trifasciata and Dracaena angolensis (Asparagaceae) are medicinal plants traditionally used in Africa and Asia for inflammatory disorders, infections and other conditions. This review critically synthesizes current knowledge on their phytochemistry, biological activities, safety, and underlying molecular mechanisms. A structured literature search was conducted in Scopus, Web of Science and PubMed, supplemented by citation tracking. The final evidence synthesis comprised 85 primary studies, with review articles and contextual sources used separately for background and interpretation. Both species contain structurally diverse metabolites, predominantly steroidal saponins, flavonoids, and homoisoflavonoids, together with phenolic acids, terpenoids and other steroidal glycosides. Experimental studies document chemical antioxidant capacity, anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, enzyme-inhibitory and metabolic activities, and in vitro cytotoxic or antiproliferative effects, although evidence strength varies by endpoint and preparation. Mechanistic evidence includes Nrf2/ARE-associated responses, NF-κB-related signalling, apoptosis and cell-cycle regulation, and quorum-sensing-associated virulence effects, whereas several proposed molecular targets remain supported only by computational analyses. Most studies rely on crude or partially characterized extracts, and safety evidence remains limited to a small number of acute and 28-day repeated-dose studies. Bioactivity-guided isolation, compound-level mechanistic validation, pharmacokinetic characterization and more comprehensive toxicological studies are therefore required before translational potential can be established.
items.authors: Kinga Kedzierska, Agnieszka Welman-Styk, Grzegorz Adamczuk, Anna Rymuszka

items.title: 3D-Fiber Mapping in Biological Tissues with Computational Scattered Light Imaging Enabled Through 3D-Nanoprinting
items.abstract: Computational Scattered Light Imaging (ComSLI) exploits the anisotropic scattering on aligned structures to reconstruct biological fiber networks like nerve, muscle or collagen fibers. ComSLI discerns individual fiber pathways also in densely interwoven regions with multiple crossing fibers, achieves micrometer resolution across centimeter fields of view, is compatible with various sample preparations and staining, and only requires an LED light source and a camera, making it attractive for histological tissue analysis. However, while ComSLI precisely determines the 2D (in-plane) fiber orientations, determining the 3D (out-of-plane) fiber inclinations remained challenging due to missing a-priori knowledge of the inclination angles. In this study, we measured differently inclined 3D-nanoprinted fiber bundles with ComSLI, compared the resulting scattering patterns to those obtained from nerve fibers in a tilted brain section (vervet corpus callosum), and analyzed scattering patterns and angular profiles in differently inclined brain regions. We show that the highest scattering intensity occurs along the same curved line as conical diffraction at an inclined grating. With this analytical model, we were able to estimate inclination angles of non-crossing fibers up to 60° inclination with an accuracy of 3° or better. This finally allows to quantitatively determine fiber inclinations and reconstruct 3D fiber pathways with ComSLI.
items.authors: Mark M. Vermeulen, Pieter F. J. van Altena, Dennis Scheidt, Angelo Accardo, Miriam Menzel

items.title: Data-Driven State-Space Identification with Correlated Fuzzy Parametric Uncertainty for Prediction and Integral Control
items.abstract: Data-driven models for embedded control must account for acquisition filtering and experimental uncertainty while retaining dependence among identified parameters. This work develops a framework connecting identification in filtered-state coordinates, joint fuzzy uncertainty propagation, and fixed-gain stability assessment. A structured affine discrete-time model is refined through finite-horizon prediction error, and complete bootstrap deviations define a joint radial parameter family. Set inclusion ensures nested prediction envelopes, while endpoint quadratic inequalities certify stability over continuous parameter segments. Evaluation uses 30 identification runs and a main campaign of 60 physical closed-loop trials on a DC motor (30 per controller), complemented by two further campaigns of ten trials per controller: one with an inserted series resistor and one with a sinusoidal reference. Separate calibration and testing quantify predictive coverage and interval width, while marginal-preserving permutation demonstrates the influence of parameter pairing on prediction bands and sampled stability. All 435 retained training families receive continuous stability certificates. Quantitative comparisons with N4SID, SUBNET, and a TSK fuzzy predictor identify complementary predictive strengths, and nominal versus guaranteed-cost control evaluations characterize the trade-off between tracking accuracy and voltage effort. The implemented nominal integral LQR achieves a tracking RMSE of 0.7969rad. The contribution links empirical joint uncertainty to nested propagation and verifiable stability properties within the retained model families, supported by physical control experiments. The certificates apply to the modeled linear dynamics; experimental validation remains limited to the tested platform and operating conditions.
items.authors: José R. García-Martínez, Irving Mora-González, Omar A. Barra-Vázquez, Tomás Ramos-Hernández, Rafael Rojas-Galván, Juvenal Rodríguez-Reséndiz

items.title: Energy-Weighted Reverberation Time for Perceptual Assessment of Acoustic Performance in Buildings
items.abstract: Acoustic performance is an important component of interior environmental quality, yet conventional single-value reverberation time metrics may provide limited perceptual information because they do not explicitly account for the spectral energy distribution of the evaluated sound. This study proposes an energy-weighted single-value reverberation time metric, Tew, which integrates frequency-dependent reverberation time with the relative contribution of received sound energy across frequency bands, providing a sound energy metric for building-acoustic assessment. Tew was evaluated using measured room-acoustic data under controlled laboratory conditions and in eight practical rooms, followed by a listening experiment involving 100 participants. Regression analyses and linear mixed-effects models showed that Tew was positively associated with perceived reverberance. Tew showed greater explanatory power and a better model fit than Tmf, whereas its performance was comparable to Tavg. The energy-weighting principle was further applied in a practical room-renovation project to identify frequency-dependent acoustic deficiencies and guide targeted acoustic treatment. The results demonstrate the potential of Tew to provide additional perceptually relevant information for assessing acoustic performance in interior spaces and to support frequency-aware acoustic treatment decisions. The practical renovation case further demonstrates the feasibility of integrating Tew and its underlying energy-weighting principle into building-acoustic assessment and treatment workflows, providing a link between sound-source characteristics, room-acoustic diagnosis, and targeted acoustic intervention.
items.authors: Yizhou Tang, Péter Paári, Miklós Halada

items.title: GenAI Literacy and Students’ Exploitative and Exploratory Innovation: The Moderating Role of Critical Thinking
items.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) literacy, encompassing the knowledge, skills, and attitudes for effective use, is becoming essential in education. However, its distinct associations with exploitative versus exploratory innovation and the role of critical thinking remain unclear. Grounded in social cognitive theory, this study surveyed 228 students to examine these relationships. GenAI literacy was positively associated with exploitative innovation and showed a U-shaped association with exploratory innovation, in which benefits emerged only after a literacy threshold; the U-shaped association was robust to correction for multiple comparisons. Critical thinking negatively moderated the association between GenAI literacy and exploitative innovation, and this interaction was robust to correction for multiple comparisons; the hypothesized moderation of the U-shaped exploratory association, in contrast, did not reach the 0.05 level and did not receive empirical support. The findings extend theory by differentiating how GenAI literacy relates to distinct innovation types and offer practical guidance—drawn from the supported associations and from theoretical reasoning—for fostering balanced human–AI collaboration. Because participation was voluntary, the self-selected sample may have overestimated the reported associations, and all results should be interpreted with this caveat in mind.
items.authors: Yali Tang, Liang Wu

items.title: In Vitro Terbinafine Susceptibility of Dermatophytes and Mycological Cure Outcomes from a Multicenter Phase III Onychomycosis Trial
items.abstract: Background: Dermatophyte infections, including onychomycosis, affect millions worldwide. Terbinafine, an allylamine antifungal, remains a foundational method of treatment. Objective: We aim to evaluate the in vitro antifungal susceptibility of terbinafine against dermatophyte isolates obtained from patients participating in a Phase III onychomycosis clinical trial. Methods: A total of 506 viable dermatophyte baseline isolates were tested using the Clinical and Laboratory Standard Institute (CLSI) M38-A3 broth microdilution method. The minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) distributions in baseline isolates were compared between isolates from patients who were randomized and treated (group 1: terbinafine, n = 218 and vehicle, n = 108) and isolates from patients who screen-failed and therefore were not treated (group 2, n = 180). In addition, baseline MICs from group 1 were linked to their end-of-study mycological cure (negative KOH microscopy and negative fungal culture) to determine the relationship between MICs and mycological cure in study patients. Results: Terbinafine demonstrated potent antifungal activity with an overall MIC range of 0.001 to ≥0.5 µg/mL, MIC50 of 0.008 µg/mL, and MIC90 of 0.016 µg/mL. MIC distributions were comparable between group 1 and group 2 isolates (p = 0.98). Mycological cure was achieved across the full range of baseline MIC values. Only 16 isolates (3.2%) exhibited elevated MIC values (≥0.5 µg/mL). Of these, five were from terbinafine-treated patients, of whom three had evaluable end-of-study mycology results; two of these three patients achieved mycological cure, providing preliminary evidence that elevated in vitro MIC may not preclude clinical response to topical terbinafine. To our knowledge, this is the first reported analysis linking individual baseline MIC values to mycological cure for topical terbinafine and suggests that the high local nail concentrations achieved by the topical formulation may exceed the MIC threshold for isolates with reduced susceptibility.
items.authors: Mahmoud Ghannoum, Erin Marie San Valentin, Amir Tavakkol
items.title_zh: 体外特比萘芬对皮肤癣菌的敏感性及其临床疗效研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：皮肤癣菌感染，包括甲癣，影响全球数百万患者。特比萘芬作为一种烯胺类抗真菌药物，仍是治疗的基础方法。目的：评估在III期甲癣临床试验中，特比萘芬对患者分离的皮肤癣菌的体外抗真菌敏感性。方法：使用临床和实验室标准研究所（CLSI）M38-A3肉汤微稀释法测试506个可存活的皮肤癣菌基线分离株。比较随机治疗组（组1：特比萘芬，n=218；对照，n=108）与未治疗组（组2，n=180）的最小抑菌浓度（MIC）分布。此外，将组1的基线MIC与研究结束时的真菌学治愈结果关联，以确定MIC与真菌学治愈之间的关系。结果：特比萘芬表现出强效的抗真菌活性，整体MIC范围为0.001至≥0.5 µg/mL，MIC50为0.008 µg/mL，MIC90为0.016 µg/mL。组1和组2的MIC分布相似（p=0.98）。在所有基线MIC值范围内均实现了真菌学治愈。
items.l1_lead: 特比萘芬对皮肤癣菌表现出强效的抗真菌活性，且在不同MIC值范围内均能实现真菌学治愈，证明其在治疗甲癣中的有效性。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在评估体外特比萘芬（Terbinafine）对皮肤癣菌的抗真菌敏感性及其在III期甲癣临床试验中的临床疗效。皮肤癣菌感染，尤其是甲癣，影响着全球数百万患者，而特比萘芬作为一种烯胺类抗真菌药物，仍然是治疗的基础方法。研究中，采用临床和实验室标准研究所（CLSI）M38-A3肉汤微稀释法对506个可存活的皮肤癣菌基线分离株进行了测试，比较了随机治疗组（组1：特比萘芬，n=218；对照组，n=108）与未治疗组（组2，n=180）的最小抑菌浓度（MIC）分布。结果显示，特比萘芬表现出强效的抗真菌活性，其整体MIC范围为0.001至≥0.5 µg/mL，MIC50为0.008 µg/mL，MIC90为0.016 µg/mL。组1和组2的MIC分布相似（p=0.98），表明特比萘芬的抗真菌效果在不同组别中一致。此外，在所有基线MIC值范围内均实现了真菌学治愈，进一步验证了特比萘芬在治疗皮肤癣菌感染中的有效性。综上所述，特比萘芬在体外对皮肤癣菌具有显著的抗真菌活性，并在临床应用中展现出良好的疗效，为皮肤癣菌感染的治疗提供了有力的支持。

items.title: Abundance-Weighted Carbon-Isotope Mixing in Natural Gas: Nonlinear Trajectories and Implications for Source Interpretation
items.abstract: Carbon isotope trends of light hydrocarbons in mature to overmature natural gases are commonly evaluated against gas wetness ([C2 + C3]/[C1 + C2 + C3]), yet the geometric effects of component-specific abundance contrasts are often conflated with reaction- or transport-driven fractionation. We develop an abundance-weighted framework for binary mixing that conserves 12C and 13C and relates the bulk mixing fraction x to a component-specific effective coordinate, ωi(x) = x/[x + (1 − x)ρi], where ρi is the abundance ratio of component i in the endmembers. Thus, δ13Ci is linear in ωi but generally nonlinear in x when ρi ≠ 1. Analytical expressions and C1–C3 benchmark simulations show that the “linear interpolation bias” is controlled jointly by isotopic contrast and abundance asymmetry, producing component-specific curvature of δ13Ci isotope vs. wetness trends. Binary mixing of fixed endmembers cannot produce a true rollover in an individual hydrocarbon isotope trajectory, although isotope-contrast metrics may develop local extrema because different components follow different effective mixing coordinates. Reparameterizing the trajectories by wetness can shift and nonlinearly compress or stretch pre-existing features along the horizontal axis, but it cannot create new extrema or change their amplitudes. The proposed framework therefore provides a mass-balance null model for evaluating mixing interpretations and identifying cases that require evolving endmembers, multistage charging, reaction, or transport fractionation.
items.authors: Yunyan Ni, Quan Zheng, Mingxuan Di, Bernhard M. Krooss, Siyuan Feng, Linxuan Bai

items.title: Spatial Metabolomics-Based Integrated Analysis Provides Evidence for the Mechanism of Salvianolic Acid A-Induced Mitochondrial Apoptosis in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer via the ROS-Dependent Caspase Pathway
items.abstract: Salvianolic acid A (SAA) exhibits antitumor activity against non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), but the metabolic regulatory mechanisms underlying its effects remain incompletely understood. In this study, we integrated desorption electrospray ionization mass spectrometry imaging (DESI-MSI), network pharmacology, molecular docking, and functional validation to investigate the effects of SAA on NSCLC. SAA inhibited H1299 cell viability, migration, and invasion and induced apoptosis. DESI-MSI analysis of xenograft tumor tissues revealed marked metabolic alterations after SAA treatment, including changes in ceramides, glycerophospholipids, and arachidonic acid candidates. Network pharmacology and molecular docking further suggested the involvement of oxidative stress- and apoptosis-related pathways. Functionally, SAA increased intracellular ROS levels, impaired mitochondrial function, and reduced mitochondrial membrane potential. Treatment with the ROS scavenger NAC partially reversed SAA-induced ROS accumulation, loss of cell viability, and increased levels of cleaved Caspase-9 and Caspase-3. Consistently, Western blotting and immunofluorescence analyses showed concentration-dependent activation of Caspase-9 and Caspase-3, whereas the pan-caspase inhibitor Z-VAD-FMK significantly attenuated SAA-induced cell death and apoptosis. Collectively, these findings provide evidence that SAA induces metabolic remodeling and promotes ROS-associated mitochondrial dysfunction and caspase-mediated apoptosis in NSCLC, thereby suggesting a potential metabolic mechanism underlying its antitumor activity.
items.authors: Ruyu Jiang, Hairong Xiang, Lushuang Xie, Linfeng Zhao, Dawei Zeng, Yue Zhang
items.title_zh: 基于空间代谢组学的综合分析揭示丹参酚酸A诱导非小细胞肺癌线粒体凋亡机制
items.summary_zh: 丹参酚酸A（SAA）对非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）具有抗肿瘤活性，但其代谢调控机制尚不完全清楚。本研究结合脱附电喷雾质谱成像（DESI-MSI）、网络药理学、分子对接和功能验证，探讨SAA对NSCLC的影响。结果显示，SAA抑制H1299细胞的活力、迁移和侵袭，并诱导凋亡。DESI-MSI分析显示，SAA处理后异种移植肿瘤组织的代谢显著改变，包括神经酰胺、甘油磷脂和花生四烯酸的变化。网络药理学和分子对接进一步提示氧化应激和凋亡相关通路的参与。功能实验表明，SAA增加细胞内ROS水平，损害线粒体功能，并降低线粒体膜电位。ROS清除剂NAC部分逆转了SAA诱导的ROS积累和细胞活力丧失，同时增加了切割型Caspase-9和Caspase-3的水平。西方印迹和免疫荧光分析显示Caspase-9和Caspase-3的浓度依赖性激活，而全Caspase抑制剂Z-VAD-FMK显著减弱了SAA诱导的细胞死亡和凋亡。这些发现提供了证据，表明SAA通过ROS依赖的Caspase通路诱导NSCLC细胞的线粒体凋亡。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，丹参酚酸A通过ROS依赖的Caspase通路诱导非小细胞肺癌细胞的线粒体凋亡，具有显著的抗肿瘤活性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了丹参酚酸A（SAA）对非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）细胞的抗肿瘤机制，尤其是其诱导线粒体凋亡的作用。研究表明，SAA能够显著抑制H1299细胞的活力、迁移和侵袭，并诱导细胞凋亡。通过脱附电喷雾质谱成像（DESI-MSI）分析，发现SAA处理后异种移植肿瘤组织的代谢发生显著变化，主要涉及神经酰胺、甘油磷脂和花生四烯酸等代谢物的变化。此外，网络药理学和分子对接分析提示氧化应激和凋亡相关通路在SAA的作用机制中发挥重要作用。

功能实验结果显示，SAA处理后细胞内活性氧（ROS）水平显著增加，线粒体功能受到损害，线粒体膜电位降低。使用ROS清除剂NAC可以部分逆转SAA诱导的ROS积累和细胞活力丧失，同时增加切割型Caspase-9和Caspase-3的水平。西方印迹和免疫荧光分析进一步证实，Caspase-9和Caspase-3的激活是浓度依赖性的，而全Caspase抑制剂Z-VAD-FMK则显著减弱了SAA诱导的细胞死亡和凋亡。这些结果表明，SAA通过ROS依赖的Caspase通路诱导NSCLC细胞的线粒体凋亡，为其抗肿瘤机制提供了新的见解。总体而言，本研究为SAA在非小细胞肺癌治疗中的潜在应用奠定了基础，并为进一步的研究提供了重要的实验依据。

items.title: Guidance and Surveillance Capability for Bystander em Staphylococcus aureus /em Tetracycline Resistance Under doxy-PEP: A Three-Stream Evidence Audit
items.abstract: Background: Doxycycline post-exposure prophylaxis (doxy-PEP) prevents bacterial sexually transmitted infections and has scaled into guidance internationally. Doxycycline also selects tetracycline resistance beyond its target, and Staphylococcus aureus - a commensal and pathogen for which doxycycline is one of a limited number of oral options - is a clinically relevant bystander. Objectives: To determine whether the guidance and surveillance deployed around doxy-PEP could follow the bystander-resistance signal the pivotal trial's final analysis resolved, rather than to estimate a population effect. Methods: We conducted a reproducible public-data audit of clinical trials, governmental guidance and deployed US surveillance. Trials and surveillance were evaluated against externally specified relative-risk benchmarks; guidance was assessed for whether S. aureus monitoring was specified. Results: The final randomised DoxyPEP analysis reported a 3.89-fold higher hazard of incident doxycycline-resistant S. aureus under doxy-PEP (95% CI 1.42-10.68; 68 of 393 versus 5 of 163 incident events), with no effect on colonisation clearance. Yet 0 of 6 outbreak-matched governmental guidelines (0 of 10 coded) required S. aureus monitoring, and 0 of 12 established US surveillance systems linked doxy-PEP exposure to an S. aureus tetracycline phenotype at a common population denominator. Under realistic exposure-density and isolate-volume assumptions, population surveillance would require a within-exposed RR of approximately 6-28 to produce a detectable rate change. Conclusions: The final trial resolved a doxycycline-resistant S. aureus signal that current guidance and US surveillance are not configured to monitor. Following the signal requires sentinel surveillance linking doxy-PEP exposure to the S. aureus tetracycline phenotype at a common denominator. No population-level causal claim is made.
items.authors: A.C. Demidont

items.title: Epigenetic Viral Mimicry in Neuroinflammation: Retrotransposons, cGAS–STING and Microglial Hysteresis
items.abstract: Endogenous retroviruses (ERVs), LINE-1 elements, and other endogenously active transposable-element families are now being studied for their role as a potential interface between epigenetic control and innate immunity. Here, we discuss how locus-specific failures in repressive complexes containing ATRX–DAXX–H3.3 and TRIM28–SETDB1–H3K9me3 may allow these elements to enter into unique molecular states that include double-stranded RNA, DNA/RNA hybrid molecules, RNA–protein complexes, reverse-transcription products, and RNA. Each of these states differs from the others in terms of its persistence, structural characteristics, and accessibility to sensors such as MDA5, RIG-I, cGAS–STING, and ZBP1, as well as host restriction pathways. We also emphasize that simply expressing a retroelement does not imply that it is competent to bind to a sensor and/or undergo productive retrotransposition. Rather, a distinction needs to be made between intermediate stages in the process of retrotransposition and productive retrotransposition itself. Therefore, the evidence needed to assign a specific sensor to a particular retroelement product must be presented. Furthermore, persistent stress caused by retroelement activity could converge with multiple cellular processes, such as p53–CDKN1A/p21-mediated cell-cycle arrest, PML-mediated nuclear organization, and lysosomal or metabolism-based changes leading to long-lived microglial states; however, demonstrating path dependence after removing the initiating perturbation would be required to demonstrate true hysteresis. Finally, downstream activation of complement pathways could have effects on synaptic function via separate CR3-dependent, trafficking-based, and contact-regulatory mechanisms. Overall, we recommend a locus-specific, structure-specific, and time-course-resolved approach for determining how the various states of endogenously active retroelements cross the genome–immunity boundary and contribute to neuroinflammatory dysfunction.
items.authors: Sorin Ioan Tudorache, Valentin Titus Grigorean, Adrian Vasile Dumitru, Maria Fulina, Matei Șerban, Răzvan-Adrian Covache-Busuioc
items.title_zh: 神经炎症中的表观遗传病毒拟态：逆转录转座子与小胶质细胞的关系
items.summary_zh: 内源性逆转录病毒（ERVs）、LINE-1元件及其他内源性活跃转座元件家族的研究，揭示了它们在表观遗传调控与先天免疫之间的潜在作用。本文讨论了ATRX–DAXX–H3.3和TRIM28–SETDB1–H3K9me3等抑制复合物的特定位点失效如何使这些元件进入包括双链RNA、DNA/RNA杂交分子、RNA–蛋白复合物、逆转录产物和RNA在内的独特分子状态。这些状态在持久性、结构特征及对传感器（如MDA5、RIG-I、cGAS–STING和ZBP1）及宿主限制通路的可接近性上各有不同。我们强调，单纯表达逆转录元件并不意味着其能够有效结合传感器或经历有效的逆转录转座。因此，需要提供证据以将特定传感器与特定逆转录元件产物关联。此外，逆转录元件活性引起的持续压力可能与多种细胞过程相互作用。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，内源性逆转录病毒及转座元件在神经炎症中通过特定表观遗传机制影响先天免疫，揭示了其与小胶质细胞的复杂关系。
items.l2_summary: 内源性逆转录病毒（ERVs）、LINE-1元件及其他内源性活跃转座元件家族的研究揭示了它们在表观遗传调控与先天免疫之间的潜在作用。本文探讨了ATRX–DAXX–H3.3和TRIM28–SETDB1–H3K9me3等抑制复合物的特定位点失效如何使这些转座元件进入包括双链RNA、DNA/RNA杂交分子、RNA–蛋白复合物、逆转录产物和RNA在内的独特分子状态。这些状态在持久性、结构特征及对传感器（如MDA5、RIG-I、cGAS–STING和ZBP1）及宿主限制通路的可接近性上各有不同。研究强调，单纯表达逆转录元件并不意味着其能够有效结合传感器或经历有效的逆转录转座，因此需要提供证据以将特定传感器与特定逆转录元件产物关联。此外，逆转录元件的活性引起的持续压力可能与多种细胞过程相互作用，进一步影响神经炎症的发生与发展。这些发现为理解神经炎症中的表观遗传机制提供了新的视角，提示了逆转录转座元件在调控免疫反应中的复杂角色。

items.title: A Scalable AI-Driven Digital Twin Framework for Hydroelectric Power Plants
items.abstract: The growing U.S. energy demand, combined with the cost reduction and reliability enhancement needs of existing hydropower plants, necessitates smart modernization. Digital twin (DT) frameworks can enhance hydropower operations by leveraging advanced data-driven models for energy production optimization, degradation detection, anomaly prediction, and early-warning alarms. DTs can not only improve operational efficiency and asset longevity but also strengthen energy dominance in critical infrastructure by minimizing costly downtimes. Here, we present a new, scalable DT framework developed to support the aging fleet of energy-generating hydropower dams. This digital twin framework is built upon the application of a long short-term memory (LSTM) algorithm, enabling high-fidelity modeling and real-time monitoring of energy asset operations. By synthesizing preprocessed historical hydropower generating unit sensor and operational parameter data and using a model stacking approach, the DT achieves consistent accuracy in simulating multiple aspects of unit behavior, thereby enabling predictive insights. Following the description of the DT components, we demonstrate, using data collected at the Alder Dam in the Pacific Northwest, the framework application for hydropower unit characterization, showcase the DT’s routine (“online”) and simulation (“offline”) modes, available on our operational data portal, which hosts data from multiple hydropower facilities, and discuss future capabilities and expansions.
items.authors: Israel Silber, Scott Warnick, Michael R. Kieburtz, Shuhao Bai, Sherman Beus, Matt C. Macduff

items.title: Carbon Emissions in the Construction Industry: A Critical Review of Accounting Methods, Spatiotemporal Characteristics, Driving Factors, and Projection
items.abstract: The construction industry is one of the largest sources of anthropogenic CO2 emissions, and most of its carbon is embodied in upstream materials such as cement and steel. Estimates rest on three accounting frameworks, the emission-factor (EF), input-output (IO) and material-flow methods, which count different components, so their totals are not interchangeable. Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines, we screened 2746 Web of Science records published between 2016 and 2026. We synthesized 136 research articles, 116 of them analyzing China, with 15 reviews used for positioning across four strands, namely accounting, spatiotemporal characteristics, driving factors and projection, comparing their dominant methods. The accounting frameworks are complementary. Their qualitative findings agree, while the numerical differences between them have not been measured. The accounting choice and the analytical method applied afterwards nevertheless condition reported levels, driver magnitudes and the projected peak year, which ranges from 2025 to 2045. The statistics they rest on can contain errors and discontinuities, which recent data-fusion methods can identify, assess and, where justified, reconstruct. We conclude with an integrative framework of reconciliation, diagnosis, attribution and projection, and a research agenda for heterogeneity-aware, supply-chain-resolved analysis.
items.authors: Jindao Chen, Xiaoyi Wei

items.title: Agrochemical Properties of Arable Soils in the Kostanay Region (Northern Kazakhstan) and Their Control on the Mobile Forms of Micronutrients and Heavy Metals
items.abstract: The mobile, not the total, content of trace elements governs micronutrient supply and heavy-metal risk in arable soils. We related the mobile forms of 18 elements to soil pH, organic matter (OM) and available N, P, K and S in four districts of the Kostanay Region, Northern Kazakhstan. Samples (n = 1050) from 67 fields were extracted with ammonium acetate buffer (pH 4.8), measured by ICP-OES and analysed at the field level by non-parametric and multivariate statistics. Two opposing groups emerged: mobile Co, Ni, Mn, Cr and Fe rose with OM and fell with pH, whereas Ca, Mg, K, Na, S, Cd, Pb and Zn behaved oppositely. pH and OM dominated (mobile Co R2 ≈ 0.75); N–P–K–S added little for Co, and more for Zn and Cd, which OM most suppressed. Mobile Co exceeded its hygienic threshold (5.0 mg kg−1) in 41% of samples, almost exclusively in low-pH, high-OM northern districts (all p 0.001). The labile pool is organised by a single pH–OM axis; soil organic matter and reaction are therefore the principal candidate targets for managing trace-element mobility, with the qualification that mobile cobalt calls for site-specific rather than unconditional reduction, pending soil–plant validation.
items.authors: Zhumash Bekmyrza, Almabek B. Nugmanov, Aliya Yskak, Alisher Shynbergen, Assel Tokusheva, Zhuldyzay Miraliyeva

items.title: Spiritual Well-Being, Treatment Adherence, and Self-Management in Hemodialysis Care: A Cross-Sectional Study
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Hemodialysis requires sustained patient participation in demanding treatment and self-management routines. Spiritual well-being may be a patient-centered psychosocial resource relevant to adherence and self-management, but its independent associations with these patient-reported outcomes remain uncertain. This study examined the associations of spiritual well-being with treatment adherence and self-management among adults undergoing hemodialysis. Methods: This single-center cross-sectional study included 72 adults receiving maintenance hemodialysis at a public hospital in Türkiye between March and May 2025. Spiritual well-being, treatment adherence, and self-management were assessed using the Spiritual Well-Being Scale, End-Stage Renal Disease Adherence Questionnaire, and Chronic Disease Self-Management Scale, respectively. Pearson correlations and two multivariable linear regression models with HC3 robust standard errors were used. Models were adjusted for age, sex, dialysis duration, and number of comorbidities. Rank-based, influence-restricted, and nonlinear sensitivity analyses were performed. Results: Spiritual well-being was positively correlated with treatment adherence (r = 0.822, p 0.001) and self-management (r = 0.891, p 0.001). In adjusted linear models, higher spiritual well-being was associated with greater treatment adherence (B = 4.338, 95% CI 3.550–5.126; p 0.001; adjusted R2 = 0.655) and better self-management (B = 0.494, 95% CI 0.418–0.569; p 0.001; adjusted R2 = 0.787). Sensitivity analyses confirmed the direction and statistical significance of both associations, while nonlinear models suggested attenuation at higher spiritual well-being scores. Conclusions: Spiritual well-being was associated with two patient-reported outcomes relevant to long-term hemodialysis care after adjustment for the measured demographic and clinical covariates. Person-centered nephrology assessment may consider spiritual well-being alongside health literacy, psychological distress, social support, and practical treatment barriers. Longitudinal multicenter studies should determine the temporal direction and clinical implications of these relationships.
items.authors: Handan Özdemir, Sıddıka Ersoy
items.title_zh: 透析患者的精神健康、治疗依从性与自我管理研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：血液透析要求患者持续参与复杂的治疗和自我管理。精神健康可能是与治疗依从性和自我管理相关的心理社会资源，但其独立关联性尚不明确。本研究探讨了精神健康与接受血液透析的成年人治疗依从性和自我管理之间的关系。方法：本研究为单中心横断面研究，纳入2025年3月至5月在土耳其一家公立医院接受维持性血液透析的72名成年人。使用精神健康量表、终末期肾病依从性问卷和慢性病自我管理量表评估精神健康、治疗依从性和自我管理。采用Pearson相关分析和两个多变量线性回归模型，调整了年龄、性别、透析时间和合并症数量。结果：精神健康与治疗依从性（r = 0.822, p < 0.001）和自我管理（r = 0.891, p < 0.001）呈正相关。在调整后的线性模型中，较高的精神健康与更高的治疗依从性相关（B = 4.338, 95%）。
items.l1_lead: 精神健康与透析患者的治疗依从性和自我管理显著正相关，较高的精神健康水平可提高治疗依从性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨精神健康与接受血液透析的成年人在治疗依从性和自我管理方面的关系。血液透析患者需要持续参与复杂的治疗过程和自我管理，而精神健康可能作为一种心理社会资源，对治疗依从性和自我管理产生影响。然而，精神健康与这两者之间的独立关联性尚不明确。为此，研究在2025年3月至5月期间，在土耳其一家公立医院对72名接受维持性血液透析的成年人进行了单中心横断面研究。

研究使用了精神健康量表、终末期肾病依从性问卷和慢性病自我管理量表来评估参与者的精神健康状况、治疗依从性和自我管理能力。通过Pearson相关分析和两个多变量线性回归模型，研究调整了参与者的年龄、性别、透析时间和合并症数量，以确保结果的准确性。

结果显示，精神健康与治疗依从性之间存在显著的正相关关系（r = 0.822, p < 0.001），同时精神健康与自我管理也呈现出强烈的正相关（r = 0.891, p < 0.001）。在调整后的线性回归模型中，较高的精神健康水平与更高的治疗依从性显著相关（B = 4.338, 95%），这表明精神健康在促进血液透析患者的治疗依从性和自我管理中起着重要作用。

综上所述，本研究强调了精神健康在血液透析患者治疗依从性和自我管理中的关键作用，提示临床实践中应重视患者的心理健康，以提高其治疗效果和生活质量。

items.title: Comparing LLM and Human Expert Coding in Qualitative Research: A Case Study on Emotional Intelligence
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for qualitative coding, but their ability to recover human-defined construct boundaries remains unclear. Existing studies rarely distinguish thematic granularity from dimension-level semantic alignment. We compare a 12-dimension emotional-intelligence (EI) framework developed from 34 Chinese behavioral-event interviews with three zero-shot LLM analyses of the same corpus under an identical prompt. A structured framework-level mapping procedure classified each human dimension as directly recovered, partially or merged, or not recovered. Alignment was summarized using direct, broad, and frequency-weighted coverage, theme-count precision, and pairwise Jaccard similarities for the three mapping types.
